subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which device operates only at the Physical layer (Layer 1) of the OSI model?
stem_hi: OSI model की केवल Physical layer (Layer 1) पर कौन-सा device काम करता है?
explanation_en: A hub is a dumb Layer-1 device — it regenerates and forwards bits to ALL ports without reading MAC addresses.
explanation_hi: Hub एक dumb Layer-1 device है — यह bits को regenerate करके सभी ports पर भेजता है, बिना MAC addresses पढ़े।
nukta_en: Layer 1 = Hub, Repeater, Modem, cables. Layer 2 = Switch, Bridge, NIC. Layer 3 = Router. Gateway = all 7 (protocol converter).
nukta_hi: Layer 1 = Hub, Repeater, Modem, cables। Layer 2 = Switch, Bridge, NIC। Layer 3 = Router। Gateway = सभी 7 (protocol converter)।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which of the following devices operates only in the physical layer?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा device केवल physical layer पर काम करता है?
explanation_en: A repeater works at Layer 1 — it only regenerates (amplifies + reshapes) the signal to extend the cable distance.
explanation_hi: Repeater Layer 1 पर काम करता है — यह केवल signal को regenerate (amplify + reshape) करके cable distance बढ़ाता है।
nukta_en: Repeater = signal regenerator (L1). Hub = multi-port repeater (L1). Both are 'dumb' devices.
nukta_hi: Repeater = signal regenerator (L1)। Hub = multi-port repeater (L1)। दोनों 'dumb' devices हैं।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which of the following pairs lists the network devices used at the physical layer?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सी जोड़ी physical layer पर उपयोग होने वाले network devices बताती है?
explanation_en: Repeater and Hub both work at the physical layer — they regenerate/forward signals without frame intelligence.
explanation_hi: Repeater और Hub दोनों physical layer पर काम करते हैं — ये signals को regenerate/forward करते हैं, बिना frame intelligence के।
nukta_en: Rajasthan PYQ (verified key: D). Physical-layer pair = Repeater + Hub. Switch/Bridge = L2, Gateway = L7.
nukta_hi: Rajasthan PYQ (verified key: D)। Physical-layer जोड़ी = Repeater + Hub। Switch/Bridge = L2, Gateway = L7।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which of the following are network connecting devices? 1. Repeater  2. Bridge  3. Hub  4. Bluetooth
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन network connecting devices हैं? 1. Repeater  2. Bridge  3. Hub  4. Bluetooth
explanation_en: Repeater, Bridge and Hub are all network connecting DEVICES; Bluetooth is a wireless TECHNOLOGY/standard, not a connecting device.
explanation_hi: Repeater, Bridge और Hub — तीनों network connecting DEVICES हैं; Bluetooth एक wireless TECHNOLOGY/standard है, connecting device नहीं।
nukta_en: Devices vs technologies: repeater/bridge/hub/switch/router = devices. Bluetooth/Wi-Fi/Ethernet = technologies/standards.
nukta_hi: Devices बनाम technologies: repeater/bridge/hub/switch/router = devices। Bluetooth/Wi-Fi/Ethernet = technologies/standards।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which of the following statements are TRUE? 1. Switch reduces collision domain. 2. Hub creates a separate collision domain for each port. 3. Router separates broadcast domains.
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं? 1. Switch collision domain को कम करता है। 2. Hub हर port के लिए अलग collision domain बनाता है। 3. Router broadcast domains को अलग करता है।
explanation_en: Statement 1 is true (each switch port = own collision domain) and 3 is true (router = broadcast-domain boundary). Statement 2 is FALSE — a hub has ONE collision domain for all its ports.
explanation_hi: कथन 1 सही है (हर switch port = अपना collision domain) और 3 सही है (router = broadcast-domain सीमा)। कथन 2 गलत है — hub के सभी ports के लिए एक ही collision domain होता है।
nukta_en: Switch: collision ↓ (per-port). Hub: 1 collision domain. Router: broadcast domains separated. Ye teeno golden statements hain.
nukta_hi: Switch: collision ↓ (per-port)। Hub: 1 collision domain। Router: broadcast domains अलग। ये तीनों golden statements हैं।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which device combines transmission from various I/O devices into one line?
stem_hi: कौन-सा device विभिन्न I/O devices के transmission को एक line में मिलाता है?
explanation_en: A multiplexer (MUX) combines several input signals into ONE shared line (FDM/TDM) at the sending end; a demultiplexer separates them again.
explanation_hi: Multiplexer (MUX) भेजने वाली ओर कई input signals को एक shared line में मिलाता है (FDM/TDM); demultiplexer उन्हें फिर अलग करता है।
nukta_en: MUX = many→one line (FDM/TDM/WDM). Concentrator = statistical sharing of a line. Gateway = protocol converter.
nukta_hi: MUX = कई→एक line (FDM/TDM/WDM)। Concentrator = line का statistical sharing। Gateway = protocol converter।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: A file server is a ______ which is used to store files received from various client machines.
stem_hi: File server एक ______ है जिसका उपयोग विभिन्न client machines से प्राप्त files संग्रहित करने के लिए होता है।
explanation_en: A file server is a specialised computer (with large storage) that stores and serves files to clients in a client-server network.
explanation_hi: File server एक विशेष computer (बड़े storage के साथ) है जो client-server network में clients को files संग्रहित करके देता है।
nukta_en: Servers (file/print/mail/web) = specialised computers. Modem = signal converter, Router = packet forwarder, Transponder = satellite relay.
nukta_hi: Servers (file/print/mail/web) = विशेष computers। Modem = signal converter, Router = packet forwarder, Transponder = satellite relay।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: In a data-entry office, computer centres on the 1st and 4th floors are connected by LANs, but signals take time to travel. Which hardware can improve the data transmission?
stem_hi: एक data-entry office में 1वीं और 4वीं मंज़िल के computer centres LAN से जुड़े हैं, पर signals में समय लगता है. बेहतर transmission के लिए कौन-सा hardware लगाएँ?
explanation_en: A repeater regenerates (amplifies and reshapes) the weakening signal — that is why it is what we install for distance problems.
explanation_hi: Repeater कमज़ोर होते signal को दोबारा ताक़तवर बनाता (regenerate करता) है — इसलिए दूरी की समस्या में यही लगता है.
nukta_en: संकेत कमज़ोर → Repeater; रास्ता चाहिए → Router; analog↔digital → Modem.
nukta_hi: संकेत कमज़ोर → Repeater; रास्ता चाहिए → Router; analog↔digital → Modem.

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: A device that operates at the physical layer of the OSI model is:
stem_hi: OSI model की physical layer पर काम करने वाला device है:
explanation_en: Repeater physical layer (Layer 1) का device है — यह signal regenerate करता है. Bridge Layer 2, Router Layer 3 पर.
explanation_hi: Repeater physical layer (Layer 1) का device है — यह signal regenerate करता है. Bridge Layer 2, Router Layer 3 पर.
nukta_en: Layer-device जोड़ी: L1 = Repeater/Hub, L2 = Bridge/Switch, L3 = Router, L4+ = Gateway.
nukta_hi: Layer-device जोड़ी: L1 = Repeater/Hub, L2 = Bridge/Switch, L3 = Router, L4+ = Gateway.

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: Which device reduces collision domains (each port has its own collision domain) but does NOT break broadcast domains?
stem_hi: कौन-सा device collision domains को कम करता है (हर port का अपना collision domain) लेकिन broadcast domains को तोड़ता नहीं?
explanation_en: A switch gives every port a separate collision domain (full-duplex = no collisions) but ALL its ports share ONE broadcast domain (unless VLANs are used).
explanation_hi: Switch हर port को अलग collision domain देता है (full-duplex = कोई collision नहीं) लेकिन सभी ports एक ही broadcast domain share करते हैं (जब तक VLAN न हो)।
nukta_en: Switch = collision domains many, broadcast 1. Router = broadcast domains many. Hub = 1 collision + 1 broadcast. VLAN = splits broadcast on a switch.
nukta_hi: Switch = collision domains कई, broadcast 1। Router = broadcast domains कई। Hub = 1 collision + 1 broadcast। VLAN = switch पर broadcast तोड़ता है।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: Which device stores MAC addresses in a CAM table?
stem_hi: कौन-सा device MAC addresses को CAM table में संग्रहित करता है?
explanation_en: A switch learns source MAC addresses and stores them in its CAM (Content Addressable Memory) table to forward frames only to the right port.
explanation_hi: Switch source MAC addresses सीखकर उन्हें अपने CAM (Content Addressable Memory) table में रखता है ताकि frames सही port पर ही भेजे जाएँ।
nukta_en: Switch = MAC table (CAM). Router = routing table (IP). Hub = no table (floods). ARP cache = IP→MAC mapping (host).
nukta_hi: Switch = MAC table (CAM)। Router = routing table (IP)। Hub = कोई table नहीं (floods)। ARP cache = IP→MAC mapping (host)।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: A switch receives a frame whose destination MAC is NOT in its MAC table. What does the switch do?
stem_hi: एक switch को frame मिलता है जिसका destination MAC उसके MAC table में नहीं है। Switch क्या करेगा?

options.text_en: Send the frame to the router only
options.text_hi: Send the frame to the router only

options.text_en: Flood the frame out of all its ports (same broadcast domain)
options.text_hi: Flood the frame out of all its ports (same broadcast domain)

options.text_en: Broadcast it on the entire internet
options.text_hi: Broadcast it on the entire internet

explanation_en: On an unknown unicast destination, the switch floods the frame out of every port (except the source port) within the broadcast domain — this is how it learns.
explanation_hi: अज्ञात unicast destination पर switch frame को हर port (source port को छोड़कर) से broadcast domain के भीतर flood करता है — इसी तरह वह सीखता है।
nukta_en: Unknown unicast → flood. Known unicast → single port. Broadcast FF:FF:... → flood. Source MAC → learn/refresh in CAM.
nukta_hi: Unknown unicast → flood। Known unicast → एक port। Broadcast FF:FF:... → flood। Source MAC → CAM में learn/refresh।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: A router is connected between two switches. If a broadcast frame is sent on Switch-A, what will Switch-B receive?
stem_hi: दो switches के बीच एक router जुड़ा है। यदि Switch-A पर broadcast frame भेजा जाए, तो Switch-B क्या प्राप्त करेगा?
explanation_en: Routers do not forward broadcast traffic — each side of the router is a separate broadcast domain, so Switch-B receives nothing.
explanation_hi: Router broadcast traffic को आगे नहीं भेजते — router के दोनों ओर अलग broadcast domains होते हैं, इसलिए Switch-B कुछ भी प्राप्त नहीं करेगा।
nukta_en: Router = broadcast firewall. This is why routers split broadcast domains and switches don't.
nukta_hi: Router = broadcast firewall। इसीलिए router broadcast domains तोड़ते हैं और switches नहीं।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: A switch has 4 VLANs configured. How many broadcast domains exist?
stem_hi: एक switch पर 4 VLANs configure हैं। कितने broadcast domains होंगे?
explanation_en: Each VLAN is its own broadcast domain — 4 VLANs = 4 broadcast domains on that switch.
explanation_hi: हर VLAN अपना अलग broadcast domain है — उस switch पर 4 VLANs = 4 broadcast domains।
nukta_en: VLAN = virtual switch = its own broadcast domain. Inter-VLAN communication needs a router (or L3 switch).
nukta_hi: VLAN = virtual switch = अपना broadcast domain। Inter-VLAN संचार के लिए router (या L3 switch) चाहिए।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: In a router-on-a-stick setup with VLANs, which device handles VLAN tagging and which handles inter-VLAN routing?
stem_hi: VLANs वाले router-on-a-stick setup में VLAN tagging कौन करता है और inter-VLAN routing कौन?

options.text_en: Both switch and router do VLAN tagging
options.text_hi: Both switch and router do VLAN tagging

explanation_en: The switch carries VLAN-tagged (802.1Q) frames on the trunk, and the router (sub-interfaces) routes between the VLANs.
explanation_hi: Switch trunk पर VLAN-tagged (802.1Q) frames ले जाता है, और router (sub-interfaces) VLANs के बीच routing करता है।
nukta_en: 802.1Q tagging = switch trunk job. Inter-VLAN routing = router (router-on-a-stick) or L3 switch.
nukta_hi: 802.1Q tagging = switch trunk का काम। Inter-VLAN routing = router (router-on-a-stick) या L3 switch।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: A packet travels: wired PC → Switch → Access Point → Wireless laptop. Which devices operate at Layer 2 only?
stem_hi: एक packet यात्रा करता है: wired PC → Switch → Access Point → Wireless laptop। कौन-से devices केवल Layer 2 पर काम करते हैं?
explanation_en: A switch is a Layer-2 device and an access point acts as a wireless bridge — also Layer-2 (it bridges 802.3 frames to 802.11 frames).
explanation_hi: Switch एक Layer-2 device है और access point एक wireless bridge की तरह काम करता है — वह भी Layer-2 (यह 802.3 frames को 802.11 frames में बदलता है)।
nukta_en: AP = wireless bridge (L2). Switch = L2. Router = L3. WAPs don't route unless configured as routers.
nukta_hi: AP = wireless bridge (L2)। Switch = L2। Router = L3। WAPs routing नहीं करते (जब तक router mode में न हों)।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: What does a MAC address represent?
stem_hi: MAC address किसका प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?

options.text_en: The location of the device in the network
options.text_hi: The location of the device in the network

options.text_en: The unique identity of the NIC
options.text_hi: The unique identity of the NIC

explanation_en: The MAC address is the unique hardware identity of the NIC (Network Interface Card) — burned in by the manufacturer.
explanation_hi: MAC address, NIC (Network Interface Card) की unique hardware पहचान है — manufacturer द्वारा burn की गई।
nukta_en: MAC = NIC identity (who). IP = location in network (where). Routing path = router's job.
nukta_hi: MAC = NIC identity (कौन)। IP = network में स्थान (कहाँ)। Routing path = router का काम।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: Which of the following component is responsible for network communication in a computer system?
stem_hi: कंप्यूटर सिस्टम में network communication के लिए कौन-सा component ज़िम्मेदार होता है?
explanation_en: Ethernet card यानी NIC (Network Interface Card) ही computer को network से जोड़ता है और frames भेजने-पाने का काम करता है.
explanation_hi: Ethernet card यानी NIC (Network Interface Card) ही computer को network से जोड़ता है और frames भेजने-पाने का काम करता है.
nukta_en: NIC = computer का network वाला हाथ — इसी पर MAC address बसा होता है.
nukta_hi: NIC = computer का network वाला हाथ — इसी पर MAC address बसा होता है.

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: LANs can be connected by which of the following devices that operate on the data link layer?
stem_hi: LANs को data link layer पर काम करने वाले निम्न में से किस device से जोड़ा जा सकता है?
explanation_en: Bridges LANs को data link layer (Layer 2) पर जोड़ते हैं और MAC addresses देखकर frames आगे भेजते हैं.
explanation_hi: Bridges LANs को data link layer (Layer 2) पर जोड़ते हैं और MAC addresses देखकर frames आगे भेजते हैं.
nukta_en: Hub = L1, Bridge/Switch = L2, Router = L3, Gateway = L4+.
nukta_hi: Hub = L1, Bridge/Switch = L2, Router = L3, Gateway = L4+.

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: Which hardware forwards data packets between computer networks?
stem_hi: कौन-सा hardware computer networks के बीच data packets को आगे भेजता है?
explanation_en: A router forwards packets between DIFFERENT networks using the routing information (IP addresses) in the packet.
explanation_hi: Router packet के भीतर routing information (IP addresses) का उपयोग करके विभिन्न networks के बीच packets को आगे भेजता है।
nukta_en: Official KVS key. Router = between networks (L3). Switch = within a network (L2). Cable = medium. Nibble = 4 bits!
nukta_hi: Official KVS key। Router = networks के बीच (L3)। Switch = network के भीतर (L2)। Cable = medium। Nibble = 4 bits!

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: Which device operates at Layer 3 of the OSI model?
stem_hi: OSI model की Layer 3 पर कौन-सा device काम करता है?
explanation_en: The router works at the Network layer (Layer 3) — it forwards packets using logical IP addresses and routing tables.
explanation_hi: Router Network layer (Layer 3) पर काम करता है — यह logical IP addresses और routing tables का उपयोग करके packets भेजता है।
nukta_en: Device-layer ladder: Repeater/Hub 1, Switch/Bridge/NIC 2, Router 3, Gateway 7.
nukta_hi: Device-layer ladder: Repeater/Hub 1, Switch/Bridge/NIC 2, Router 3, Gateway 7।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: Among these network devices — i. Repeater  ii. Hub  iii. Switch  iv. Router — which are considered intelligent devices?
stem_hi: इन network devices में — i. Repeater  ii. Hub  iii. Switch  iv. Router — कौन-से intelligent devices माने जाते हैं?
explanation_en: Switch and router are intelligent — they read addresses (MAC/IP) and make forwarding decisions; repeater and hub blindly repeat/forward signals.
explanation_hi: Switch और router intelligent हैं — ये addresses (MAC/IP) पढ़कर forwarding decisions लेते हैं; repeater और hub अंधों की तरह signals दोहराते/भेजते हैं।
nukta_en: Intelligent = reads addresses + filters/forwards selectively (switch, router, bridge, gateway). Dumb = hub, repeater.
nukta_hi: Intelligent = addresses पढ़ता है + selectively filter/forward करता है (switch, router, bridge, gateway)। Dumb = hub, repeater।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: A router performs which of the following? (1) Packet forwarding  (2) Logical addressing  (3) Collision detection  (4) Routing decision
stem_hi: Router निम्न में से कौन-सा कार्य करता है? (1) Packet forwarding  (2) Logical addressing  (3) Collision detection  (4) Routing decision
explanation_en: A router forwards packets, uses logical (IP) addressing and makes routing decisions — but collision detection is a Layer-2 (CSMA/CD) function, not a router's.
explanation_hi: Router packets भेजता है, logical (IP) addressing उपयोग करता है और routing decisions लेता है — लेकिन collision detection Layer-2 (CSMA/CD) का काम है, router का नहीं।
nukta_en: Router = forward + route + logical addressing. NOT collision detection (that's Ethernet L2 on switches/NICs).
nukta_hi: Router = forward + route + logical addressing। Collision detection नहीं (वह switches/NICs पर Ethernet L2 का काम है)।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: Consider: S1: The TTL field decreases at each router. S2: The MAC address changes at each hop. Which is correct?
stem_hi: देखिए: S1: TTL field हर router पर घटती है। S2: MAC address हर hop पर बदलता है। कौन-सा सही है?
explanation_en: At every router hop the TTL is decremented (and header checksum recomputed) AND a new frame with new source/destination MAC addresses is built. Both statements are true.
explanation_hi: हर router hop पर TTL घटती है (और header checksum फिर से बनता है) और नए source/destination MAC addresses वाला नया frame बनता है। दोनों कथन सही हैं।
nukta_en: Per-hop changes: TTL↓ + MAC rewritten. End-to-end: IP addresses unchanged (except NAT).
nukta_hi: Per-hop बदलाव: TTL↓ + MAC फिर से लिखा जाता है। End-to-end: IP addresses अपरिवर्तित (NAP को छोड़कर)।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: A router drops some packets deliberately due to congestion. What is this technique called?
stem_hi: Router congestion के कारण कुछ packets जानबूझकर छोड़ देता है। इस तकनीक को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: Random Early Detection (RED) proactively drops (or marks) packets before the queue is full, signalling senders to slow down — a congestion-avoidance technique.
explanation_hi: Random Early Detection (RED) queue भरने से पहले ही packets छोड़ (या mark) देता है, जिससे senders धीमे हो जाएँ — यह एक congestion-avoidance तकनीक है।
nukta_en: Congestion tools: RED (early random drops), Queuing (FIFO/PQ), Traffic shaping. Dropping ALL at overflow = tail drop.
nukta_hi: Congestion tools: RED (early random drops), Queuing (FIFO/PQ), Traffic shaping। Overflow पर सब छोड़ना = tail drop।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: Which device creates a separate broadcast domain?
stem_hi: कौन-सा device अलग broadcast domain बनाता है?
explanation_en: Each router interface belongs to a different broadcast domain — the router is the boundary between them.
explanation_hi: हर router interface अलग broadcast domain से संबंधित होता है — router उनके बीच की सीमा है।
nukta_en: Broadcast domain boundary = router (or VLAN). Collision domain boundary = switch port/bridge.
nukta_hi: Broadcast domain सीमा = router (या VLAN)। Collision domain सीमा = switch port/bridge।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: If two systems use DIFFERENT protocols, which device is used to link them?
stem_hi: यदि दो systems भिन्न protocols उपयोग करते हैं, तो उन्हें जोड़ने के लिए कौन-सा device उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: A gateway is a protocol converter — it translates between different protocols/architectures so dissimilar systems can communicate.
explanation_hi: Gateway एक protocol converter है — यह विभिन्न protocols/architectures के बीच अनुवाद करता है ताकि भिन्न systems संवाद कर सकें।
nukta_en: Gateway = protocol converter (L7). Bridge = similar LANs, same protocols (L2). Repeater/Hub = signal level (L1).
nukta_hi: Gateway = protocol converter (L7)। Bridge = समान LANs, समान protocols (L2)। Repeater/Hub = signal level (L1)।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which device can operate across all 7 layers of the OSI model?
stem_hi: कौन-सा device OSI model की सभी 7 layers पर काम कर सकता है?
explanation_en: A gateway (protocol converter) works at the application layer and may involve all layers to translate between different protocol stacks.
explanation_hi: Gateway (protocol converter) application layer पर काम करता है और भिन्न protocol stacks के बीच अनुवाद के लिए सभी layers को शामिल कर सकता है।
nukta_en: Gateway = 'all 7 layers' device. Hub 1, switch/bridge 2, router 3 — exam one-liner.
nukta_hi: Gateway = 'सभी 7 layers' वाला device। Hub 1, switch/bridge 2, router 3 — exam one-liner।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Devices on one network can communicate with devices on another network via:
stem_hi: एक network के devices दूसरे network के devices से किसके माध्यम से संवाद कर सकते हैं?
explanation_en: A gateway connects different networks (often with different protocols) and lets their devices communicate — the entry/exit point between networks.
explanation_hi: Gateway विभिन्न networks (अक्सर भिन्न protocols वाले) को जोड़ता है और उनके devices को संवाद करने देता है — networks के बीच प्रवेश/निकास बिंदु।
nukta_en: Gateway = network-to-network doorway (also default gateway = router IP used to exit the LAN).
nukta_hi: Gateway = network-to-network दरवाज़ा (default gateway भी = LAN से बाहर निकलने के लिए router IP)।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which type of firewall inspects packets at the network layer and decides based on IP addresses?
stem_hi: कौन-सी firewall network layer पर packets की जाँच करके IP addresses के आधार पर निर्णय लेती है?
explanation_en: A packet-filtering firewall works at the network layer — it allows/denies packets by source/destination IP (and ports) using ACL rules.
explanation_hi: Packet-filtering firewall network layer पर काम करती है — यह ACL rules से source/destination IP (और ports) के आधार पर packets को allow/deny करती है।
nukta_en: Firewall types: Packet filtering (L3/L4, stateless) → Stateful (tracks sessions) → Proxy/Application gateway (L7) → Circuit-level gateway (L5).
nukta_hi: Firewall types: Packet filtering (L3/L4, stateless) → Stateful (sessions याद रखती है) → Proxy/Application gateway (L7) → Circuit-level gateway (L5)।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which firewall acts as an intermediary between the client and server at the application layer?
stem_hi: कौन-सी firewall application layer पर client और server के बीच मध्यस्थ (intermediary) के रूप में काम करती है?
explanation_en: A proxy (application) firewall terminates the client connection and opens a separate connection to the server — hiding the internal client completely.
explanation_hi: Proxy (application) firewall client connection समाप्त करके server के लिए अलग connection खोलती है — internal client को पूरी तरह छिपाती है।
nukta_en: Proxy = L7 intermediary (deep inspection, hides internals). Circuit gateway = L5 (session/relay).
nukta_hi: Proxy = L7 intermediary (गहरी जाँच, internals छिपाती है)। Circuit gateway = L5 (session/relay)।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: What is the role of a firewall in computer networks?
stem_hi: Computer networks में firewall की भूमिका क्या है?
explanation_en: A firewall monitors and filters incoming/outgoing traffic according to security rules — protecting the trusted network from unauthorised access.
explanation_hi: Firewall security rules के अनुसार आने-जाने वाले traffic की निगरानी और छँटनी करता है — trusted network को unauthorised access से बचाता है।
nukta_en: Firewall = traffic filter between trusted & untrusted networks (screening router, DMZ...). DHCP = IP management; DNS = names.
nukta_hi: Firewall = trusted और untrusted networks के बीच traffic filter (screening router, DMZ...)। DHCP = IP management; DNS = names।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: What is the purpose of a proxy server in networking?
stem_hi: Networking में proxy server का उद्देश्य क्या है?
explanation_en: A proxy server sits between clients and the internet — it filters requests (policy, caching) and forwards them, hiding the client's identity.
explanation_hi: Proxy server clients और internet के बीच बैठता है — यह requests को filter (policy, caching) करके आगे भेजता है, client की पहचान छिपाता है।
nukta_en: Proxy = filter + forward + cache + hide client. Firewall = block/allow by rules. Both are security/traffic devices.
nukta_hi: Proxy = filter + forward + cache + client छिपाना। Firewall = rules से block/allow। दोनों security/traffic devices हैं।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which is a network security system designed to protect a trusted private network from an untrusted outside network to which it is connected?
stem_hi: कौन-सी network security system trusted private network को उस जुड़े हुए untrusted outside network से बचाने के लिए बनी है?
explanation_en: A firewall is the security system placed between a trusted internal network and an untrusted external network (like the Internet).
explanation_hi: Firewall एक security system है जो trusted internal network और untrusted external network (जैसे Internet) के बीच लगाया जाता है।
nukta_en: Rajasthan PYQ (verified key: C) — the classic firewall definition. Compare: bridge = L2 link, cookie = web state, SSL = encryption.
nukta_hi: Rajasthan PYQ (verified key: C) — firewall की classic परिभाषा। तुलना: bridge = L2 link, cookie = web state, SSL = encryption।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: What kind of NAT maps one private IP to exactly one public IP?
stem_hi: किस प्रकार का NAT एक private IP को ठीक एक public IP से जोड़ता है?
explanation_en: Static NAT creates a permanent one-to-one mapping between a private and a public IP address (used for servers).
explanation_hi: Static NAT एक private और एक public IP address के बीच स्थायी one-to-one mapping बनाता है (servers के लिए उपयोग)।
nukta_en: NAT types: Static = 1↔1 permanent. Dynamic = pool mapping. PAT/NAT-overload = many↔1 using ports.
nukta_hi: NAT types: Static = 1↔1 स्थायी। Dynamic = pool mapping। PAT/NAT-overload = ports से many↔1।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which of the following is NOT a networking device?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा networking device नहीं है?
explanation_en: Linux is an operating system, not a networking device — gateway, router and firewall are all network devices/functions.
explanation_hi: Linux एक operating system है, networking device नहीं — gateway, router और firewall सब network devices/functions हैं।
nukta_en: Device vs OS: hardware devices (hub/switch/router) vs software (OS, antivirus) vs firmware-based security devices (firewall).
nukta_hi: Device बनाम OS: hardware devices (hub/switch/router) बनाम software (OS, antivirus) बनाम firmware-based security devices (firewall)।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which of the following is NOT a networking device? (Hub / Switch / Bridge / None of these)
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा networking device नहीं है? (Hub / Switch / Bridge / इनमें से कोई नहीं)
explanation_en: Hub, switch and bridge are ALL networking devices — so the answer is 'None of these'.
explanation_hi: Hub, switch और bridge — तीनों networking devices हैं — इसलिए उत्तर 'इनमें से कोई नहीं' है।
nukta_en: Mirror question of the 'Linux' variant — read the option SET carefully: here everything listed IS a device.
nukta_hi: 'Linux' वाले प्रश्न का दर्पण — option SET ध्यान से पढ़ें: यहाँ सूचीबद्ध सब devices हैं।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: All ports of a hub belong to how many collision domains?
stem_hi: Hub के सभी ports कितने collision domains में आते हैं?
explanation_en: Hub ek shared medium hai — sab ports ek hi collision domain.
explanation_hi: Hub में सब ports एक collision domain।
nukta_en: Switch mein har port alag.
nukta_hi: Switch में हर port अलग।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: A device that regenerates a weak signal bit-by-bit to its original strength is a:
stem_hi: कमज़ोर signal को bit-by-bit पुनः मूल शक्ति तक लाने वाला उपकरण है:
explanation_en: Repeater signal copy karke regenerate karta hai — amplify nahi.
explanation_hi: Repeater regenerate करता है — amplify नहीं।
nukta_en: Amplifier shor ke saath badhata hai.
nukta_hi: Amplifier शोर भी बढ़ाता है।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: A 24-port hub creates how many collision domains?
stem_hi: 24-port hub कितने collision domains बनाता है?
explanation_en: Hub ek shared segment hai — saare ports ek hi collision domain mein hain (switch hota to har port apna collision domain).
explanation_hi: Hub एक shared segment है — सारे ports एक ही collision domain में (switch में हर port अलग)।
nukta_en: Hub = layer-1 dumb device, signal ko sab ports par repeat karta hai.
nukta_hi: Hub = layer-1 device, signal सब ports पर repeat करता है।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: A switch learns the port for a MAC address by:
stem_hi: Switch किसी MAC address का port कैसे सीखता है?

options.text_en: Reading the source MAC of incoming frames
options.text_hi: आने वाले frames के source MAC से

explanation_en: Switch incoming frame ka source MAC dekh kar CAM table bharta hai.
explanation_hi: Switch source MAC देखकर CAM table भरता है।
nukta_en: Destination MAC se forwarding hoti hai, learning source se.
nukta_hi: Learning source MAC से।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: VLANs on a switch are used to create:
stem_hi: Switch पर VLAN बनाए जाते हैं:
explanation_en: VLAN = ek switch par alag broadcast domains.
explanation_hi: VLAN = अलग broadcast domains।
nukta_en: Collision domain to switch pehle hi har port par deta hai.
nukta_hi: Collision domain हर port पर पहले से।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: Compared to a hub, a switch:
stem_hi: Hub की तुलना में switch:

options.text_en: Sends every frame to all ports
options.text_hi: हर frame सब ports पर भेजता है

options.text_en: Sends frames only to the destination port
options.text_hi: Frame सिर्फ़ destination port पर भेजता है
सिर्फ़ layer 3 पर काम करता है

explanation_en: Switch MAC table se frame ko sahi port par bhejta hai.
explanation_hi: Switch MAC table से सही port पर भेजता है।
nukta_en: Hub sabko bhejta hai.
nukta_hi: Hub सबको भेजता है।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: Connecting each switch port to a single host so that every port becomes its own collision domain is called:
stem_hi: Switch के हर port पर एक host लगाकर उसे अलग collision domain बनाना कहलाता है:
explanation_en: Microsegmentation se collisions khatam — full-duplex possible; trunking = multiple VLANs ka traffic ek link par.
explanation_hi: Microsegmentation से collisions खत्म; trunking = कई VLANs का traffic एक link पर।
nukta_en: Collision domain ka size chhota karna hi microsegmentation hai.
nukta_hi: Collision domain छोटा करना = microsegmentation।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: On a managed switch, which feature restricts a port to specific MAC addresses so that unauthorized hosts cannot connect?
stem_hi: Managed switch पर कौन-सी सुविधा एक port को तय MAC addresses तक सीमित करती है ताकि अनधिकित host न जुड़ सकें?
explanation_en: Port Security: ek port par allowed MAC addresses (sticky/static) fix karo; adhik aane par port err-disable ho jaata hai. Pattern: SSC CGL + CCNA/Network+.
explanation_hi: Port Security: port पर allowed MAC तय; उल्लंघन पर port बंद। Pattern: SSC CGL + CCNA।
nukta_en: VTP = VLAN config distribute; STP = loops roke; mirroring = traffic copy.
nukta_hi: VTP = VLAN config; STP = loop रोके; mirroring = traffic copy।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: When a router forwards a packet, which header field does NOT change?
stem_hi: Router के packet forward करने पर कौन-सा header field नहीं बदलता?
explanation_en: TTL ghat-ta hai, checksum naya hota hai; source IP same.
explanation_hi: TTL घटता है, checksum नया; source IP same।
nukta_en: TTL/checksum dono badalte hain.
nukta_hi: TTL/checksum दोनों बदलते हैं।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: A brouter is a device that can act as:
stem_hi: Brouter वह उपकरण है जो बन सकता है:
explanation_en: Brouter = bridge + router dono ki functionality.
explanation_hi: Brouter = bridge + router।
nukta_en: Baaki combos asli devices nahi.
nukta_hi: बाक़ी combos नहीं।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: A brouter forwards non-routable protocols (e.g., NetBEUI) at OSI layer ______ and routable protocols (e.g., IP) at layer 3:
stem_hi: Brouter non-routable protocols (जैसे NetBEUI) को OSI layer ______ पर और routable protocols (IP) को layer 3 पर भेजता है:
explanation_en: Brouter = bridge + router: jin protocols par routing possible nahi unke liye bridge (layer 2) ki tarah; routable ke liye router (layer 3) ki tarah.
explanation_hi: Brouter = bridge + router: गैर-routable के लिए bridge (layer 2), routable के लिए router (layer 3)।
nukta_en: Bridge ka kaam = MAC addresses se frame forward karna.
nukta_hi: Bridge = MAC addresses से frame forward करता है।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: A firewall that keeps track of the state of live connections is called:
stem_hi: वह firewall जो चालू connections की state याद रखता है, कहलाता है:
explanation_en: Stateful firewall connection ka state table rakhta hai.
explanation_hi: Stateful firewall state table रखता है।
nukta_en: Packet filter sirf headers dekhta hai.
nukta_hi: Packet filter सिर्फ़ headers।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: The area where public-facing servers (web, mail) are placed for security is called:
stem_hi: जहाँ public servers (web, mail) सुरक्षा हेतु रखे जाते हैं, वह क्षेत्र है:
explanation_en: DMZ = Demilitarized Zone — firewall ke beech ka public area.
explanation_hi: DMZ = Demilitarized Zone।
nukta_en: VLAN switch ki virtual LAN hai.
nukta_hi: VLAN virtual LAN है।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which NAT type uses a single public IP for many internal hosts?
stem_hi: कौन-सी NAT कई internal hosts के लिए एक ही public IP प्रयोग करती है?
explanation_en: PAT ports se differentiate karta hai.

stem_hi: एक channel की bandwidth अधिक है लेकिन noise बहुत है। कौन-सी encoding scheme बेहतर error resistance देगी?
explanation_en: Manchester encoding has a transition in every bit period — the receiver resynchronises quickly and detects errors easily, giving strong noise resilience.
explanation_hi: Manchester encoding में हर bit period में transition होता है — receiver जल्दी resynchronise होता है और errors आसानी से पकड़ लेता है, इसलिए noise resilience मज़बूत है।
nukta_en: Manchester = self-clocking + DC-free + strong error visibility. NRZ = long runs → clock loss in noise.
nukta_hi: Manchester = self-clocking + DC-free + मज़बूत error visibility। NRZ = लंबे runs → noise में clock loss।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Which of the following Ethernet encodings has the highest redundancy?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सी Ethernet encoding की redundancy सबसे अधिक है?
explanation_en: 1B2B encodes every 1 bit as 2 bits — 100% redundancy, the highest of the four (4B5B = 25%, 5B6B = 20%, 8B10B = 25%).
explanation_hi: 1B2B हर 1 bit को 2 bits के रूप में encode करती है — 100% redundancy, चारों में सबसे अधिक (4B5B = 25%, 5B6B = 20%, 8B10B = 25%)।
nukta_en: Redundancy (overhead): 1B2B 100% > 4B5B/8B10B 25% > 5B6B 20%. More redundancy = better clocking/error properties, more bandwidth.
nukta_hi: Redundancy (overhead): 1B2B 100% > 4B5B/8B10B 25% > 5B6B 20%। ज़्यादा redundancy = बेहतर clocking/error properties, ज़्यादा bandwidth।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Which encoding technique is used to transmit signals in Gigabit Ethernet over fiber optic medium?
stem_hi: Fiber optic medium पर Gigabit Ethernet में signal भेजने के लिए कौन-सी encoding technique उपयोग होती है?
explanation_en: Gigabit Ethernet (1000BASE-X over fiber) uses 8B/10B encoding — 8 data bits are carried as 10 code bits for clocking and DC balance.
explanation_hi: Gigabit Ethernet (fiber पर 1000BASE-X) 8B/10B encoding उपयोग करता है — 8 data bits को 10 code bits के रूप में भेजा जाता है (clocking और DC balance के लिए)।
nukta_en: 100BASE-TX uses 4B/5B + MLT-3; 1000BASE-X uses 8B/10B; 10GBASE-R uses 64B/66B. Ye exam favourite ladder hai.
nukta_hi: 100BASE-TX में 4B/5B + MLT-3; 1000BASE-X में 8B/10B; 10GBASE-R में 64B/66B। यह exam favourite ladder है।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: The primary use of scramblers in line coding schemes is to:
stem_hi: Line coding schemes में scramblers का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है?
explanation_en: A scrambler randomises the transmitted bit pattern (breaks long runs of 0s/1s) so the receiver recovers the clock easily — it does NOT compress or change bandwidth.
explanation_hi: Scrambler transmitted bit pattern को randomise करता है (लंबे 0s/1s के runs तोड़ता है) ताकि receiver आसानी से clock recover कर सके — यह compress या bandwidth नहीं बदलता।
nukta_en: unverified supplied answer-table claim. Scrambler = random-looking line signal (clock recovery). Not compression, not encryption.
nukta_hi: unverified supplied answer-table claim। Scrambler = random-looking line signal (clock recovery)। Compression नहीं, encryption नहीं।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Reduction in signal strength over distance is called:
stem_hi: दूरी के साथ signal strength में कमी को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: Attenuation is the gradual loss of signal strength (amplitude) as it travels along a medium — measured in dB/km (or dB/100 ft).
explanation_hi: Attenuation medium के साथ यात्रा करते समय signal strength (amplitude) का क्रमिक नुकसान है — इसे dB/km (या dB/100 ft) में मापा जाता है।
nukta_en: Impairments: Attenuation (strength loss), Distortion (shape change), Noise (unwanted signals). Attenuation ↑ with distance & frequency.
nukta_hi: Impairments: Attenuation (strength loss), Distortion (shape change), Noise (unwanted signals)। Attenuation ↑ distance और frequency के साथ।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: In a copper cable, attenuation increases with frequency. Which change will REDUCE attenuation?
stem_hi: Copper cable में attenuation frequency के साथ बढ़ता है। कौन-सा बदलाव attenuation घटाएगा?
explanation_en: A thicker copper core has lower electrical resistance — so the signal loses less strength over distance.
explanation_hi: मोटे copper core का electrical resistance कम होता है — इसलिए signal को दूरी पर कम strength गँवानी पड़ती है।
nukta_en: Reduce attenuation: shorter cable, thicker/better copper, higher category cable, lower frequency, or add repeaters/amplifiers.
nukta_hi: Attenuation घटाना: छोटी cable, मोटा/बेहतर copper, उच्च श्रेणी cable, कम frequency, या repeaters/amplifiers जोड़ें।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Which noise is caused by electromagnetic coupling between nearby cables?
stem_hi: पास की cables के बीच electromagnetic coupling से कौन-सा noise होता है?
explanation_en: Crosstalk is the unwanted signal leakage from one wire pair to a neighbouring pair caused by electromagnetic coupling.
explanation_hi: Crosstalk एक wire pair से पास की दूसरी pair में electromagnetic coupling के कारण होने वाला unwanted signal leakage है।
nukta_en: Noise types: Thermal (random electron motion), Crosstalk (pair-to-pair coupling), Impulse (sudden spikes), Quantization (PCM sampling).
nukta_hi: Noise types: Thermal (random electron motion), Crosstalk (pair-to-pair coupling), Impulse (sudden spikes), Quantization (PCM sampling)।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Which impairment cannot be completely eliminated but only minimised?
stem_hi: कौन-सा impairment पूरी तरह समाप्त नहीं किया जा सकता, केवल कम किया जा सकता है?
explanation_en: Noise can never be fully eliminated — it can only be minimised (shielding, better cable, lower power, error control).
explanation_hi: Noise कभी पूरी तरह समाप्त नहीं हो सकती — केवल कम की जा सकती है (shielding, बेहतर cable, कम power, error control)।
nukta_en: Attenuation/distortion can be fixed with repeaters/equalisers; noise is fundamental (thermal floor) — only minimised.
nukta_hi: Attenuation/distortion repeaters/equalisers से ठीक हो सकते हैं; noise मूलभूत है (thermal floor) — केवल कम होती है।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Which parameter of an analog signal represents the number of cycles per second?
stem_hi: Analog signal का कौन-सा parameter प्रति सेकंड cycles की संख्या दर्शाता है?
explanation_en: Frequency is the number of signal cycles completed per second, measured in Hertz (Hz).
explanation_hi: Frequency प्रति सेकंड पूरे होने वाले signal cycles की संख्या है, जिसे Hertz (Hz) में मापा जाता है।
nukta_en: Signal parameters: Amplitude (height), Frequency (cycles/sec), Phase (start position), Wavelength (distance/cycle = speed/frequency).
nukta_hi: Signal parameters: Amplitude (ऊँचाई), Frequency (cycles/sec), Phase (शुरुआती स्थिति), Wavelength (दूरी/cycle = speed/frequency)।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: The period of a signal is 100 ms. What is its frequency in kilohertz?
stem_hi: एक signal की period 100 ms है। इसकी frequency kilohertz में कितनी होगी?
explanation_en: Frequency f = 1/T = 1/0.1 s = 10 Hz = 0.01 kHz = 10⁻² kHz.
explanation_hi: Frequency f = 1/T = 1/0.1 s = 10 Hz = 0.01 kHz = 10⁻² kHz।
nukta_en: f = 1/T. 100 ms = 0.1 s → 10 Hz. Convert Hz→kHz by dividing by 1000.
nukta_hi: f = 1/T। 100 ms = 0.1 s → 10 Hz। Hz→kHz के लिए 1000 से भाग दें।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: ______ signals are discrete and are generated by digital modulation.
stem_hi: ______ signals discrete होते हैं और digital modulation से बनते हैं।
explanation_en: Digital signals are discrete (defined only at instants) and are produced by digital modulation techniques.
explanation_hi: Digital signals discrete होते हैं (केवल कुछ क्षणों पर परिभाषित) और digital modulation techniques से बनते हैं।
nukta_en: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (B). Analog = continuous; Digital = discrete. Ye sabse basic signal distinction hai.
nukta_hi: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (B)। Analog = continuous; Digital = discrete। यह signal का सबसे बुनियादी भेद है।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Quantizing noise occurs in:
stem_hi: Quantizing noise किसमें होती है?
explanation_en: Quantizing noise is the small error introduced when an analog sample is rounded to the nearest discrete level in PCM.
explanation_hi: Quantizing noise वह छोटी त्रुटि है जो PCM में analog sample को निकटतम discrete level पर गोल करने से आती है।
nukta_en: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (A). PCM = sampling + quantizing + encoding → quantizing error = quantization noise.
nukta_hi: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (A)। PCM = sampling + quantizing + encoding → quantizing error = quantization noise।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: If the channel bandwidth is limited to 6 kHz and the signal-to-noise ratio is 16, what is the channel capacity?
stem_hi: यदि channel bandwidth 6 kHz सीमित है और signal-to-noise ratio 16 है, तो channel capacity कितनी होगी?
explanation_en: By Shannon's capacity formula C = B × log₂(1 + SNR) = 6000 × log₂(17) ≈ 6000 × 4.09 ≈ 24.5-24.7 kbps — matching 24.74 kbps.
explanation_hi: Shannon capacity सूत्र से C = B × log₂(1 + SNR) = 6000 × log₂(17) ≈ 6000 × 4.09 ≈ 24.5-24.7 kbps — 24.74 kbps से मेल खाता है।
nukta_en: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (B). Shannon: C = B log₂(1+SNR). Nyquist: C = 2B log₂(L) (noiseless).
nukta_hi: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (B)। Shannon: C = B log₂(1+SNR)। Nyquist: C = 2B log₂(L) (noiseless)।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Given a bit rate of b bits/sec, the time required to send 16 bits is:
stem_hi: यदि bit rate b bits/sec है, तो 16 bits भेजने में कितना समय लगेगा?
explanation_en: Time = number of bits ÷ bit rate = 16 ÷ b = 16/b seconds.
explanation_hi: Time = bits की संख्या ÷ bit rate = 16 ÷ b = 16/b seconds।
nukta_en: Time = size/rate. 1000 bits at 100 bps = 10 s. Units: bits ÷ (bits/sec) = sec.
nukta_hi: Time = size/rate। 1000 bits at 100 bps = 10 s। Units: bits ÷ (bits/sec) = sec।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: The effective bandwidth of a communication channel is primarily limited by:
stem_hi: Communication channel की effective bandwidth मुख्य रूप से किससे सीमित होती है?
explanation_en: Noise (with attenuation) limits how much data can be reliably pushed through a channel — Shannon's law shows capacity grows with bandwidth and SNR but is capped by noise.
explanation_hi: Noise (attenuation के साथ) तय करती है कि channel से कितना data भरोसेमंद तरीके से भेजा जा सकता है — Shannon का नियम दिखाता है कि capacity bandwidth और SNR के साथ बढ़ती है पर noise से सीमित रहती है।
nukta_en: Effective bandwidth is a physics/SNR limit. Protocol overhead reduces goodput but is not the channel's fundamental limit.
nukta_hi: Effective bandwidth एक physics/SNR सीमा है। Protocol overhead goodput घटाता है पर channel की मूल सीमा नहीं।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: What technique allows multiple signals to share the same communication channel?
stem_hi: कौन-सी technique कई signals को एक ही communication channel share करने देती है?
explanation_en: Multiplexing combines multiple signals onto one shared medium (FDM/TDM/WDM/CDM) — a demultiplexer separates them at the receiving end.
explanation_hi: Multiplexing कई signals को एक shared medium पर जोड़ती है (FDM/TDM/WDM/CDM) — receiving end पर demultiplexer उन्हें अलग करता है।
nukta_en: Multiplexing = many share one channel. FDM = frequency bands, TDM = time slots, WDM = light wavelengths, CDM = codes.
nukta_hi: Multiplexing = कई एक channel share करें। FDM = frequency bands, TDM = time slots, WDM = light wavelengths, CDM = codes।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Communication using a modulated carrier to apply a data signal to a transmission medium in analog form is:
stem_hi: Modulated carrier का उपयोग करके data signal को analog रूप में transmission medium पर डालना क्या कहलाता है?
explanation_en: Broadband networking sends data as a modulated analog carrier; baseband sends digital signals directly on the medium.
explanation_hi: Broadband networking data को modulated analog carrier के रूप में भेजता है; baseband digital signals सीधे medium पर भेजता है।
nukta_en: Baseband = digital signalling (Manchester etc.). Broadband = analog carriers + modulation (FDM channels).
nukta_hi: Baseband = digital signalling (Manchester आदि)। Broadband = analog carriers + modulation (FDM channels)।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: The amount of data transmitted in a fixed amount of time is called:
stem_hi: निश्चित समय में भेजे गए data की मात्रा को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: Bandwidth (in this exam phrasing) is the data transmitted per unit time — the communication channel's capacity (bps).
explanation_hi: इस exam शैली में Bandwidth प्रति इकाई समय भेजा गया data है — communication channel की capacity (bps)।
nukta_en: Strictly: THROUGHPUT = data actually sent per second; BANDWIDTH = maximum capacity. Banks often call throughput 'bandwidth' — read options carefully.
nukta_hi: कठोरता से: THROUGHPUT = वास्तव में प्रति सेकंड भेजा data; BANDWIDTH = अधिकतम capacity। Banks अक्सर throughput को 'bandwidth' कहते हैं — options ध्यान से पढ़ें।

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Consider a noiseless channel with a bandwidth of 5000 Hz transmitting a signal with two signal levels. The maximum bit rate is:
stem_hi: एक noiseless channel जिसकी bandwidth 5000 Hz है, दो signal levels के साथ transmission कर रहा है. अधिकतम bit rate होगी:
explanation_en: Nyquist के सूत्र से: Max data rate = 2 × B × log₂(L) = 2 × 5000 × log₂(2) = 10000 bps.
explanation_hi: Nyquist के सूत्र से: Max data rate = 2 × B × log₂(L) = 2 × 5000 × log₂(2) = 10000 bps.
nukta_en: UGC NET Jan 2025 official key (ii). याद रखो: 2B log₂L (noiseless) और B log₂(1+S/N) (noisy — Shannon).
nukta_hi: UGC NET Jan 2025 official key (ii). याद रखो: 2B log₂L (noiseless) और B log₂(1+S/N) (noisy — Shannon).

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Communication using a modulated carrier to apply a data signal to a transmission medium in analog form is called:
stem_hi: Modulated carrier का उपयोग करके data signal को analog रूप में transmission medium पर भेजना कहलाता है:
explanation_en: Broadband में data को modulated carrier (analog) के ऊपर भेजा जाता है; baseband में digital signal सीधे medium पर जाता है.
explanation_hi: Broadband में data को modulated carrier (analog) के ऊपर भेजा जाता है; baseband में digital signal सीधे medium पर जाता है.
nukta_en: Baseband = digital, सीधा; Broadband = analog, modulated. यह जोड़ी परीक्षा में बार-बार.
nukta_hi: Baseband = digital, सीधा; Broadband = analog, modulated. यह जोड़ी परीक्षा में बार-बार.

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Identify the odd one out: Optical fibre, Twisted pair wire, Microwaves, Hertz
stem_hi: असंगत वस्तु पहचानें: Optical fibre, Twisted pair wire, Microwaves, Hertz
explanation_en: Optical fibre, Twisted pair और Microwaves — तीनों transmission media हैं; Hertz आवृत्ति की इकाई है — medium नहीं.
explanation_hi: Optical fibre, Twisted pair और Microwaves — तीनों transmission media हैं; Hertz आवृत्ति की इकाई है — medium नहीं.
nukta_en: Media = रास्ता; Hertz = गति/आवृत्ति माप. यही अंतर पूछा गया है.
nukta_hi: Media = रास्ता; Hertz = गति/आवृत्ति माप. यही अंतर पूछा गया है.

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: Which of the following is NOT a type of broadband internet connection?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा broadband internet connection का प्रकार नहीं है?
explanation_en: Dial-up पुरानी सुस्त (कम bandwidth) तकनीक है — broadband नहीं. Cable, DSL और Satellite broadband हैं.
explanation_hi: Dial-up पुरानी सुस्त (कम bandwidth) तकनीक है — broadband नहीं. Cable, DSL और Satellite broadband हैं.
nukta_en: Broadband = fast internet (Cable/DSL/Fibre/Satellite); Dial-up = टेलीफ़ोन वाला पुराना संस्करण.
nukta_hi: Broadband = fast internet (Cable/DSL/Fibre/Satellite); Dial-up = टेलीफ़ोन वाला पुराना संस्करण.

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Assertion (A): Fiber optic cable is immune to electromagnetic interference (EMI). Reason (R): It transmits data in the form of light pulses rather than electrical signals. Which option is correct?
stem_hi: Assertion (A): Fiber optic cable electromagnetic interference (EMI) से मुक्त है। Reason (R): यह data electrical signals के बजाय light pulses के रूप में भेजती है। कौन-सा विकल्प सही है?

options.text_en: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
options.text_hi: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

options.text_en: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation
options.text_hi: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation

explanation_en: Fiber is immune to EMI (A is true) precisely BECAUSE it carries light, not electrical current (R is true and explains A).
explanation_hi: Fiber EMI से मुक्त है (A सही) क्योंकि यह electrical current नहीं, प्रकाश ले जाता है (R सही और A की व्याख्या करता है)।
nukta_en: Fiber = light pulses → EMI-proof + tap-proof + huge bandwidth. Copper = electrical → EMI/crosstalk prone.
nukta_hi: Fiber = light pulses → EMI-proof + tap-proof + विशाल bandwidth। Copper = electrical → EMI/crosstalk प्रवण।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Which statements are TRUE for fiber optic cables? I. Immune to tapping  II. High bandwidth  III. Requires electrical grounding  IV. Works using total internal reflection
stem_hi: Fiber optic cables के लिए कौन-से कथन सही हैं? I. Tapping से मुक्त  II. उच्च bandwidth  III. Electrical grounding चाहिए  IV. Total internal reflection से काम करती है
explanation_en: Fiber carries light (hard to tap, huge bandwidth, works on total internal reflection) and being glass/dielectric it needs NO electrical grounding.
explanation_hi: Fiber प्रकाश ले जाती है (tapping कठिन, विशाल bandwidth, total internal reflection पर काम) और काँच/dielectric होने से इसे electrical grounding की आवश्यकता नहीं।
nukta_en: Fiber truths: immune to tapping & EMI, highest bandwidth, TIR propagation. Myths: grounding (NO), affected by lightning (NO).
nukta_hi: Fiber truths: tapping और EMI से मुक्त, सर्वोच्च bandwidth, TIR propagation। Myths: grounding (नहीं), lightning (नहीं)।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Optical fiber uses reflection to guide light through a channel. At total internal reflection, the angle of incidence is ______ the critical angle.
stem_hi: Optical fiber प्रकाश को channel में भेजने के लिए reflection उपयोग करती है। Total internal reflection में angle of incidence, critical angle से ______ होता है।
explanation_en: Total internal reflection happens only when the angle of incidence is GREATER than the critical angle — then light stays inside the core.
explanation_hi: Total internal reflection केवल तब होती है जब angle of incidence critical angle से अधिक हो — तब प्रकाश core के भीतर ही रहता है।
nukta_en: TIR rule: angle of incidence > critical angle (denser → rarer medium). Ye fiber propagation ka base hai.
nukta_hi: TIR rule: angle of incidence > critical angle (denser → rarer medium)। यह fiber propagation का आधार है।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: A company needs long-distance communication (5-10 km), high data rate and immunity from electromagnetic interference. Which medium is best?
stem_hi: एक कंपनी को लंबी दूरी (5-10 km) संचार, उच्च data rate और EMI से मुक्ति चाहिए। कौन-सा medium सर्वोत्तम है?
explanation_en: Single-mode fiber carries one light ray tens of kilometres with very high data rates and is completely immune to EMI.
explanation_hi: Single-mode fiber एक light ray को दसियों किलोमीटर तक बहुत उच्च data rates के साथ ले जाती है और पूरी तरह EMI से मुक्त है।
nukta_en: Fiber choices: Multi-mode = short (LANs, few hundred m). Single-mode = long haul (km) + highest rate. Copper = short & EMI-prone.
nukta_hi: Fiber विकल्प: Multi-mode = छोटी दूरी (LANs, कुछ सौ m)। Single-mode = लंबी (km) + उच्चतम rate। Copper = छोटी और EMI-प्रवण।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: A network uses coaxial cable but suffers from signal reflection. What is the most likely cause?
stem_hi: एक network coaxial cable उपयोग करता है लेकिन signal reflection से पीड़ित है। सबसे संभावित कारण क्या है?
explanation_en: Coaxial cable must be terminated with its characteristic impedance (e.g., 50Ω/75Ω); a mismatch causes signal reflections back down the cable.
explanation_hi: Coaxial cable को उसकी characteristic impedance (जैसे 50Ω/75Ω) से terminate करना अनिवार्य है; mismatch होने पर signal cable में वापस reflect होते हैं।
nukta_en: Coax rule: proper termination (BNC/terminator) prevents reflections. Un-terminated bus = standing waves & echoes.
nukta_hi: Coax rule: सही termination (BNC/terminator) reflections रोकता है। Un-terminated bus = standing waves और echoes।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: A UTP cable used in Gigabit Ethernet shows high delay skew. What is the cause?
stem_hi: Gigabit Ethernet में उपयोग UTP cable में delay skew अधिक है। कारण क्या है?

options.text_en: Different twist rates in the cable pairs
options.text_hi: Different twist rates in the cable pairs

explanation_en: Each pair in a UTP cable is twisted at a slightly different rate (to reduce crosstalk) — so signals arrive with small timing differences, called delay skew.
explanation_hi: UTP cable में हर pair थोड़ी अलग दर से twisted होता है (crosstalk घटाने के लिए) — इसलिए signals थोड़े अलग समय पर पहुँचते हैं, इसे delay skew कहते हैं।
nukta_en: Delay skew = pair-to-pair propagation time difference (tight twist → shorter wire → less skew). Cat6 has tighter specs for Gigabit.
nukta_hi: Delay skew = pair-to-pair propagation time अंतर (tight twist → छोटी wire → कम skew)। Cat6 में Gigabit के लिए कड़े specs हैं।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Which of the following best explains why fiber optic cables have a lower bit error rate than copper cables?
stem_hi: Fiber optic cables की copper cables की तुलना में कम bit error rate की सबसे अच्छी व्याख्या कौन-सी है?
explanation_en: Fiber carries light and is immune to EMI/crosstalk/impulse noise — the main causes of bit errors in copper — so its BER is far lower.
explanation_hi: Fiber प्रकाश ले जाती है और EMI/crosstalk/impulse noise से मुक्त है — जो copper में bit errors के मुख्य कारण हैं — इसलिए इसका BER बहुत कम होता है।
nukta_en: Fiber wins on: EMI immunity, low attenuation, huge bandwidth, tap security.
nukta_hi: Fiber में श्रेष्ठता: EMI immunity, कम attenuation, विशाल bandwidth, tap security।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Which transmission medium works on the principle of total internal reflection?
stem_hi: कौन-सा transmission medium total internal reflection के सिद्धांत पर काम करता है?
explanation_en: In optical fiber, light stays inside the glass core by total internal reflection (angle of incidence > critical angle).
explanation_hi: Optical fiber में प्रकाश total internal reflection के कारण glass core के भीतर रहता है (angle of incidence > critical angle)।
nukta_en: Fiber = TIR. Copper media use electrical signals (electromagnetic fields), not light reflection.
nukta_hi: Fiber = TIR। Copper media electrical signals (electromagnetic fields) उपयोग करते हैं, प्रकाश reflection नहीं।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Crosstalk in twisted pair cables is typically minimised by:
stem_hi: Twisted pair cables में crosstalk आमतौर पर किससे कम होता है?
explanation_en: Tightening the twists equalises coupling and cancels interference between pairs — higher categories (Cat6/6a) use tighter twists.
explanation_hi: Tight twists coupling को संतुलित करते हैं और pairs के बीच interference रद्द करते हैं — उच्च श्रेणियों (Cat6/6a) में tighter twists होते हैं।
nukta_en: Anti-crosstalk tricks: tighter twists, pair separation, shielding (STP), lower power.
nukta_hi: Anti-crosstalk tricks: tighter twists, pair separation, shielding (STP), कम power।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: What is the typical maximum length of a UTP cable in Ethernet before signal degradation?
stem_hi: Signal degradation से पहले Ethernet में UTP cable की सामान्य अधिकतम लंबाई कितनी होती है?
explanation_en: Standard Ethernet UTP runs are limited to 100 metres (about 90 m of solid cable + 10 m of patch cords).
explanation_hi: Standard Ethernet UTP runs 100 मीटर तक सीमित हैं (लगभग 90 m solid cable + 10 m patch cords)।
nukta_en: Copper distance limits: UTP Ethernet 100 m, Thinnet 185 m, Thicknet 500 m, Fiber (multi-mode) ~550 m-2 km, (single-mode) tens of km.
nukta_hi: Copper distance limits: UTP Ethernet 100 m, Thinnet 185 m, Thicknet 500 m, Fiber (multi-mode) ~550 m-2 km, (single-mode) दसियों km।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Which connector is commonly used for coaxial cable in physical networks?
stem_hi: Physical networks में coaxial cable के लिए सामान्यतः कौन-सा connector उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: Coaxial networks use BNC connectors (with a terminator at the ends); RJ-45 is for twisted pair, HDMI for displays, USB-C for peripherals.
explanation_hi: Coaxial networks BNC connectors उपयोग करते हैं (छोर पर terminator के साथ); RJ-45 twisted pair के लिए, HDMI display के लिए, USB-C peripherals के लिए।
nukta_en: Connectors: RJ-45 (UTP Ethernet), BNC (coax/Thinnet), SC/ST/LC (fiber), RJ-11 (telephone).
nukta_hi: Connectors: RJ-45 (UTP Ethernet), BNC (coax/Thinnet), SC/ST/LC (fiber), RJ-11 (telephone)।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Which transmission medium is primarily used in modern internet backbone networks?
stem_hi: आधुनिक internet backbone networks में मुख्य रूप से कौन-सा transmission medium उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: Modern backbones use single-mode fiber — huge bandwidth over very long distances with low loss.
explanation_hi: आधुनिक backbones single mode fiber उपयोग करते हैं — लंबी दूरी पर कम loss के साथ विशाल bandwidth।
nukta_en: Backbone = single-mode fiber (undersea/terrestrial cables). LAN = UTP. Old cable TV = coax. Remote areas = microwave/satellite.
nukta_hi: Backbone = single-mode fiber (undersea/terrestrial cables)। LAN = UTP। पुराना cable TV = coax। दूरस्थ क्षेत्र = microwave/satellite।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Which transmission medium is best for a network exposed to heavy electrical interference?
stem_hi: भारी electrical interference वाले network के लिए कौन-सा transmission medium सर्वोत्तम है?
explanation_en: Optical fiber is immune to electrical/EMI interference because it transmits light, not electrical signals.
explanation_hi: Optical fiber electrical/EMI interference से मुक्त है क्योंकि यह electrical signals नहीं, प्रकाश भेजती है।
nukta_en: EMI-heavy areas (factories, power plants) → fiber. 'Immune to EMI' = keyword for fiber.
nukta_hi: EMI-भारी क्षेत्र (कारखाने, power plants) → fiber। 'Immune to EMI' = fiber के लिए keyword।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Which of the following CANNOT be used as a medium for 802.3 Ethernet?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा 802.3 Ethernet के लिए medium उपयोग नहीं किया जा सकता?
explanation_en: 802.3 Ethernet is a wired standard — it runs on coax, twisted pair and fiber, but NOT on microwave (that is 802.11/wireless).
explanation_hi: 802.3 Ethernet एक wired standard है — यह coax, twisted pair और fiber पर चलता है, लेकिन microwave पर नहीं (वह 802.11/wireless है)।
nukta_en: 802.3 = Ethernet (wired: 10Base2/5, 10Base-T, 100Base-TX, 1000Base-X...). 802.11 = Wi-Fi (wireless).
nukta_hi: 802.3 = Ethernet (wired: 10Base2/5, 10Base-T, 100Base-TX, 1000Base-X...)। 802.11 = Wi-Fi (wireless)।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Which of the following is NOT a type of transmission medium?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा transmission medium का प्रकार नहीं है?
explanation_en: A NIC (Network Interface Card) is a hardware adapter — a device, not a transmission medium.
explanation_hi: NIC (Network Interface Card) एक hardware adapter है — एक device है, transmission medium नहीं।
nukta_en: Media = guided (twisted pair, coax, fiber) + unguided (radio, microwave, satellite, infrared). NIC = adapter.
nukta_hi: Media = guided (twisted pair, coax, fiber) + unguided (radio, microwave, satellite, infrared)। NIC = adapter।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Which cable has the maximum bandwidth?
stem_hi: किस cable की bandwidth अधिकतम होती है?
explanation_en: Optical fiber offers the highest bandwidth — hundreds of Gbps to Tbps over long distances.
explanation_hi: Optical fiber सर्वोच्च bandwidth देती है — लंबी दूरी पर सैकड़ों Gbps से Tbps तक।
nukta_en: Bandwidth order: Fiber >> Coax > Twisted pair. USB is a peripheral bus, not a network cable type here.
nukta_hi: Bandwidth क्रम: Fiber >> Coax > Twisted pair। USB peripheral bus है, यहाँ network cable type नहीं।

subtopic: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
stem_en: Which of the following is a wireless networking technology?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सी wireless networking technology है?
explanation_en: Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11) is a wireless LAN technology; Ethernet (802.3), fiber and DSL are all wired.
explanation_hi: Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11) एक wireless LAN technology है; Ethernet (802.3), fiber और DSL सब wired हैं।
nukta_en: Wireless family: Wi-Fi (802.11), Bluetooth (802.15), WiMAX (802.16), mobile (GSM/LTE/5G).
nukta_hi: Wireless family: Wi-Fi (802.11), Bluetooth (802.15), WiMAX (802.16), mobile (GSM/LTE/5G)।

subtopic: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
stem_en: Which wireless standard provides the highest data rate?
stem_hi: कौन-सा wireless standard सर्वोच्च data rate देता है?
explanation_en: 802.11ac (Wi-Fi 5) offers the highest rate among these — up to multi-Gbps (5 GHz, MU-MIMO, wide channels).
explanation_hi: 802.11ac (Wi-Fi 5) इनमें सर्वोच्च rate देता है — तक मल्टी-Gbps (5 GHz, MU-MIMO, wide channels)।
nukta_en: Wi-Fi rates: b = 11 Mbps, g = 54 Mbps, n = 600 Mbps, ac = multi-Gbps. Order: b < g < n < ac.
nukta_hi: Wi-Fi rates: b = 11 Mbps, g = 54 Mbps, n = 600 Mbps, ac = multi-Gbps। क्रम: b < g < n < ac।

subtopic: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
stem_en: Which type of wireless transmission requires line-of-sight?
stem_hi: किस प्रकार की wireless transmission के लिए line-of-sight आवश्यक है?
explanation_en: Infrared transmission needs a direct line-of-sight (or reflection) between transmitter and receiver — it cannot pass through walls.
explanation_hi: Infrared transmission के लिए transmitter और receiver के बीच सीधी line-of-sight (या reflection) चाहिए — यह दीवारों से नहीं गुजरती।
nukta_en: IR = line-of-sight (TV remotes, IrDA). Radio/RF (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) passes through walls (with loss).
nukta_hi: IR = line-of-sight (TV remotes, IrDA)। Radio/RF (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) दीवारों से गुजरते हैं (loss के साथ)।

subtopic: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
stem_en: Which of the following statements is NOT true about microwaves?
stem_hi: Microwaves के बारे में निम्न में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?

options.text_en: They are electromagnetic waves with frequencies from 300 GHz to 400 THz
options.text_hi: They are electromagnetic waves with frequencies from 300 GHz to 400 THz

options.text_en: Very high-frequency waves cannot penetrate walls
options.text_hi: Very high-frequency waves cannot penetrate walls

options.text_en: Use of certain portions of the band requires permission from authorities
options.text_hi: Use of certain portions of the band requires permission from authorities

explanation_en: Microwaves range roughly 300 MHz to 300 GHz — '300 GHz to 400 THz' is the infrared region, so this statement is false.
explanation_hi: Microwaves की range लगभग 300 MHz से 300 GHz है — '300 GHz से 400 THz' infrared क्षेत्र है, इसलिए यह कथन गलत है।
nukta_en: Microwaves: 300 MHz-300 GHz, line-of-sight, no wall penetration, licensed bands. Exam asks the odd range out.
nukta_hi: Microwaves: 300 MHz-300 GHz, line-of-sight, दीवार नहीं भेदते, licensed bands। Exam गलत range पूछता है।

subtopic: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
stem_en: Which transmission medium is used in Bluetooth technology?
stem_hi: Bluetooth technology में कौन-सा transmission medium उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: Bluetooth (IEEE 802.15.1) uses short-range radio links in the 2.4 GHz ISM band.
explanation_hi: Bluetooth (IEEE 802.15.1) 2.4 GHz ISM band में short-range radio links उपयोग करता है।
nukta_en: Bluetooth = 2.4 GHz radio, WPAN (802.15), ~10-100 m range, frequency hopping.
nukta_hi: Bluetooth = 2.4 GHz radio, WPAN (802.15), ~10-100 m range, frequency hopping।

subtopic: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
stem_en: Which physical-layer technique allows multiple users to share the same bandwidth simultaneously?
stem_hi: कौन-सी physical-layer technique कई users को एक ही bandwidth साथ-साथ share करने देती है?
explanation_en: In CDMA every user transmits over the SAME bandwidth at the SAME time, separated by unique codes.
explanation_hi: CDMA में हर user एक ही bandwidth पर एक ही समय में transmit करता है, अलग-अलग codes से अलग किया जाता है।
nukta_en: Sharing methods: FDMA = frequency bands, TDMA = time slots, CDMA = codes (same band+time).
nukta_hi: Sharing methods: FDMA = frequency bands, TDMA = time slots, CDMA = codes (same band+time)।

subtopic: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
stem_en: Select the FALSE statement about CDMA technology: I. CDMA optimises the use of available bandwidth as it transmits over the entire frequency range. II. Each user in a CDMA system uses a different code to modulate their signal. III. CDMA offers less security compared to GSM technology. IV. A SIM card is always required for a CDMA device to work.
stem_hi: CDMA technology के बारे में गलत कथन चुनिए: I. CDMA उपलब्ध bandwidth के उपयोग को अनुकूलित करता है क्योंकि यह पूरी frequency range पर transmit करता है। II. CDMA system में हर user अपने signal को modulate करने के लिए अलग code उपयोग करता है। III. CDMA, GSM की तुलना में कम security देता है। IV. CDMA device के काम करने के लिए SIM card हमेशा आवश्यक है।
explanation_en: Statements III and IV are false: CDMA offers STRONGER security than GSM (spread spectrum + codes), and CDMA devices can work without a SIM (older CDMA handsets).
explanation_hi: कथन III और IV गलत हैं: CDMA, GSM से मज़बूत security देता है (spread spectrum + codes), और CDMA devices बिना SIM के भी चल सकते हैं (पुराने CDMA handsets)।
nukta_en: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (D). True: I (spread over full band) and II (unique codes per user). False: III (CDMA more secure) and IV (SIM not mandatory).
nukta_hi: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (D)। सही: I (पूरे band पर spread) और II (हर user का unique code)। गलत: III (CDMA अधिक सुरक्षित) और IV (SIM अनिवार्य नहीं)।

stem_en: In NRZ-I encoding, a binary 1 is represented by:
stem_hi: NRZ-I encoding में binary 1 को दर्शाया जाता है:

options.text_en: A transition at the beginning of the bit interval

subtopic: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
stem_en: A noiseless channel has a bandwidth of 4 kHz and uses 16 signal levels. Per Nyquist's theorem, the maximum bit rate is:
stem_hi: एक noiseless channel की bandwidth 4 kHz है और वह 16 signal levels प्रयोग करती है। Nyquist के अनुसार अधिकतम bit rate होगी:
explanation_en: Nyquist: C = 2 × B × log2(L) = 2 × 4000 × log2(16) = 2 × 4000 × 4 = 32 kbps. Pattern: RPSC Programmer/DD + GATE-style signal numerics.
explanation_hi: Nyquist: C = 2 × 4000 × log2(16) = 32 kbps। Pattern: RPSC Programmer/DD + GATE-style।
nukta_en: Shannon (noise wala) = B log2(1+SNR); Nyquist (noiseless) = 2B log2(L) — mix mat karna.
nukta_hi: Shannon = B log2(1+SNR); Nyquist = 2B log2(L)।

stem_en: Which twisted-pair cable standard supports 10 Gbps Ethernet over the full 100 m channel?

explanation_en: Cat6a = 10 Gbps @ 100 m (augmented, alien-crosstalk controlled); Cat6 = 10 Gbps sirf ~55 m tak.

stem_en: A coaxial cable consists of ______ concentric copper conductors:
stem_hi: Coaxial cable में ______ संकेंद्रित (concentric) copper conductors होते हैं:
explanation_en: Coax: beech mein inner copper conductor, uske chaaron taraf outer copper shield — dono ke beech insulator. Isi se EMI resistance aati hai.
explanation_hi: Coax: भीतरी copper conductor और बाहरी copper shield — बीच में insulator।
nukta_en: UTP = 4 pairs (8 wires); coax = 2 concentric conductors.
nukta_hi: UTP = 4 pairs; coax = 2 संकेंद्रित conductors।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: 10Base5, 10Base2 and 10BaseT are different types of:
stem_hi: 10Base5, 10Base2 और 10BaseT हैं किसके अलग-अलग प्रकार:
explanation_en: Ye sab Ethernet cable standards hain: 10 Mbps; Base = baseband. 10Base5 = thick coax (Thicknet), 10Base2 = thin coax (Thinnet), 10BaseT = UTP.
explanation_hi: ये सब Ethernet cable standards हैं (10 Mbps, baseband): 10Base5 thick coax, 10Base2 thin coax, 10BaseT UTP।
nukta_en: Suffix: 5/2 = segment length (sau metre mein); T = twisted pair.
nukta_hi: Suffix: 5/2 = segment length (सौ मीटर में); T = twisted pair।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: In the Ethernet names 10Base2 and 10Base5, the digits '2' and '5' indicate:
stem_hi: Ethernet नामों 10Base2 और 10Base5 में अंक '2' और '5' बताते हैं:

options.text_en: Maximum segment length in hundreds of metres (~200 m and ~500 m)
options.text_hi: अधिकतम segment लंबाई, सौ मीटर में (~200 m और ~500 m)

explanation_en: 10Base2 = ~185-200 m (thin coax), 10Base5 = 500 m (thick coax) — '10' = 10 Mbps, 'Base' = baseband.
explanation_hi: 10Base2 = ~185-200 m; 10Base5 = 500 m; '10' = 10 Mbps; 'Base' = baseband।
nukta_en: Speed '10' mein hai; digits 2/5 distance mein (sau metre).
nukta_hi: Speed '10' में; अंक 2/5 दूरी में (सौ मीटर)।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: The function of a DSLAM (DSL Access Multiplexer) located at the telephone exchange is to:
stem_hi: Telephone exchange पर स्थित DSLAM (DSL Access Multiplexer) का काम है:

options.text_en: Aggregate many DSL subscriber lines onto a high-speed backbone link
options.text_hi: कई DSL subscriber lines को high-speed backbone link पर इकट्ठा करना
Digital voice को analog में बदलना

options.text_en: Assign IP addresses to DSL modems
options.text_hi: DSL modems को IP addresses देना

explanation_en: DSLAM: exchange par sab DSL lines multiplex karke backbone par daalta hai (aur aksar ISP routing tak). Ghar par DSL modem hota hai.
explanation_hi: DSLAM: exchange पर सभी DSL lines को backbone पर multiplex करता है; घर पर DSL modem होता है।
nukta_en: DHCP = IP dena; modem = signal convert; DSLAM = aggregation.
nukta_hi: DHCP = IP; modem = signal convert; DSLAM = aggregation।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: Cable Internet access (HFC) differs from DSL in that:
stem_hi: Cable Internet access (HFC), DSL से भिन्न है क्योंकि:

options.text_en: The HFC bandwidth is shared among all subscribers on the neighbourhood segment
options.text_hi: HFC bandwidth पड़ोस के segment के सभी subscribers में साझा होती है

options.text_en: It uses the telephone line's DSLAM
options.text_hi: यह telephone line का DSLAM प्रयोग करता है

options.text_en: It cannot carry television signals simultaneously
options.text_hi: यह television signals साथ नहीं चला सकता

options.text_en: Each subscriber gets a dedicated fibre pair
options.text_hi: हर subscriber को dedicated fibre जोड़ी मिलती है

explanation_en: HFC (Hybrid Fibre-Coax): fibre tak, phir coax — segment ka bandwidth shared (peak hours par slow). DSL mein har line exchange tak dedicated hoti hai.
explanation_hi: HFC: bandwidth साझा (peak hours पर धीमा); DSL में हर line exchange तक dedicated।
nukta_en: DSL = dedicated last-mile; Cable = shared coax segment.
nukta_hi: DSL = dedicated last-mile; Cable = shared coax segment।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: In SONET (Synchronous Optical Networking), the base electrical signal level STS-1 has a data rate of approximately:
stem_hi: SONET में, आधार electrical signal level STS-1 की data rate लगभग होती है:
explanation_en: STS-1 = 51.84 Mbps; STS-3 = 155.52 (OC-3); STS-12 = 622.08 (OC-12) — har level n × STS-1.
explanation_hi: STS-1 = 51.84 Mbps; STS-3 = 155.52; STS-12 = 622.08 — हर level n × STS-1।
nukta_en: Yaad karo: STS-1 = 51.84 Mbps, aur OC-n/STS-n = n × 51.84.
nukta_hi: STS-1 = 51.84 Mbps; OC-n/STS-n = n × 51.84।

subtopic: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
stem_en: In the SONET protocol stack, the photonic layer corresponds to which layer of the OSI model?

explanation_en: SONET ke 4 layers: Photonic (physical/electrical-optical), Section, Line, Path — Photonic layer light signals/green-red lasers ka kaam sambhalti hai.
explanation_hi: SONET की 4 layers: Photonic, Section, Line, Path — Photonic = physical।
nukta_en: Section/Line/Path = overhead management levels; Photonic = actual light.
nukta_hi: Section/Line/Path = overhead; Photonic = प्रकाश संकेत।

stem_en: What is the main disadvantage of Stop-and-Wait flow control?

explanation_en: Waiting after every frame leaves the line idle — efficiency drops sharply, especially on long-distance links.

stem_en: A Go-Back-N sender uses window size 4. Frame 2 is lost. What happens after the receiver receives frames 3 and 4?

explanation_hi: GBN receiver सिर्फ अगली in-order frame चाहता है — frame 2 खोने पर 3 और 4 out-of-order हैं, इसलिए उन्हें discard कर दिया जाता है.

stem_en: The message 11001001 is to be transmitted using the CRC polynomial x³ + 1 to protect it from errors. The codeword that should be transmitted is:

explanation_en: x³ + 1 = 1001. Message के आगे 3 zeros लगाकर 11001001000 को 1001 से भाग दो → remainder 011. जोड़ने पर codeword = 11001001011.
explanation_hi: x³ + 1 = 1001. Message के आगे 3 zeros लगाकर 11001001000 को 1001 से भाग दो → remainder 011. जोड़ने पर codeword = 11001001011.

stem_en: A 2 km long broadcast LAN has 10⁷ bps bandwidth and uses CSMA/CD. The signal travels along the wire at 2 × 10⁸ m/s. What is the minimum packet size that can be used on this network?
stem_hi: एक 2 km लंबे broadcast LAN की bandwidth 10⁷ bps है और यह CSMA/CD उपयोग करता है. Signal तार में 2 × 10⁸ m/s से चलता है. इस network पर उपयोग होने वाला न्यूनतम packet आकार कितना है?
explanation_en: न्यूनतम frame = 2 × d × R / v = 2 × 2000 × 10⁷ / (2 × 10⁸) = 200 bits = 25 bytes. यह किसी दिए option में नहीं — इसलिए 'None of the above'.
explanation_hi: न्यूनतम frame = 2 × d × R / v = 2 × 2000 × 10⁷ / (2 × 10⁸) = 200 bits = 25 bytes. यह किसी दिए option में नहीं — इसलिए 'None of the above'.
nukta_en: GATE 2003 और RPSC 2011 दोनों का official key (D). याद रखो: min frame = 2 × propagation delay × bandwidth (round-trip).

subtopic: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
stem_en: A network using CSMA/CD has a bandwidth of 20 Mbps. If the maximum propagation time is 25 µs, what is the minimum size of the frame?
