explanation_en: Minimum frame = 2 × Tp × BW = 2 × 25µs × 20 Mbps = 2 × 25×10⁻⁶ × 20×10⁶ = 1000 bits.
explanation_hi: Minimum frame = 2 × Tp × BW = 2 × 25µs × 20 Mbps = 2 × 25×10⁻⁶ × 20×10⁶ = 1000 bits.
nukta_en: UGC NET Jan 2025 key (ii). यही formula ऊपर वाले GATE प्रश्न में भी — बस units बदलो.

subtopic: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
stem_en: A CSMA/CD network transmits data at 100 Mbps over a 1 km cable with no repeaters. If the minimum frame size required is 1250 bytes, what is the signal speed in the cable (in km/sec)?
stem_hi: एक CSMA/CD network बिना repeaters के 1 km cable पर 100 Mbps से data भेजता है. यदि आवश्यक न्यूनतम frame आकार 1250 bytes हो, तो cable में signal की गति (km/sec में) कितनी है?
explanation_en: Min frame = 2dR/v → v = 2dR/L = 2 × 1 km × 10⁸ bps / (1250×8 bits) = 2×10⁸/10⁴ = 20000 km/sec.
explanation_hi: Min frame = 2dR/v → v = 2dR/L = 2 × 1 km × 10⁸ bps / (1250×8 bits) = 2×10⁸/10⁴ = 20000 km/sec.

nukta_hi: GATE 2015 key (d) 20000 km/s. Formula को उलटकर speed निकालना — यही इस प्रश्न का खेल है.

stem_en: Why is bit stuffing required in bit-oriented protocols?

options.text_hi: To prevent confusion between data and the flag

explanation_hi: Flag pattern (जैसे HDLC की 01111110) data में भी आ सकती है — confusion रोकने के लिए data में हर पाँच 1s के बाद एक 0 ठूँस दिया जाता है (bit stuffing).
nukta_en: Bit stuffing = data को flag से अलग पहचान दिलाना.
nukta_hi: Bit stuffing = data को flag से अलग पहचान दिलाना.

options.text_hi: Appending a nibble to the flag sequence

options.text_hi: Appending a nibble to the user data stream

explanation_hi: User (data) stream में पाँच लगातार 1s के बाद एक 0 जोड़ा जाता है ताकि data, flag से अलग पहचाना जा सके.

stem_en: In Ethernet CSMA/CD, the special sequence transmitted by media access management to handle a collision is called:

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: The minimum size of an Ethernet frame (excluding preamble) is:

stem_en: What is the MTU size for Ethernet?
stem_hi: Ethernet के लिए MTU आकार कितना है?

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: In Ethernet, the minimum frame size is fixed mainly to:
stem_hi: Ethernet में न्यूनतम frame आकार मुख्य रूप से किसलिए तय किया गया है?
explanation_en: In CSMA/CD the sender must detect collisions while transmitting — so the frame must be long enough for the signal to complete a round trip. That is the 64-byte limit.
explanation_hi: CSMA/CD में sender को transmission के दौरान collision detect करना होता है — इसलिए frame इतना बड़ा होना चाहिए कि signal round-trip पूरा कर सके. 64 bytes की यही सीमा है.
nukta_en: Round-trip time (slot time) तक frame ज़िंदा रहे — तभी collision पकड़ी जाएगी.
nukta_hi: Round-trip time (slot time) तक frame ज़िंदा रहे — तभी collision पकड़ी जाएगी.

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer

explanation_hi: MAC (Media Access Control) sub-layer ही medium तक पहुँच का नियम बनाता है — CSMA/CD, CSMA/CA आदि यहीं लागू होते हैं.

nukta_hi: MAC = Medium Access Control — नाम में ही 'medium access' लिखा है.

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: What is the primary function of the MAC sublayer?
stem_hi: MAC sublayer का मुख्य काम क्या है?
explanation_en: The MAC sub-layer's main job is controlling access to the channel (medium) — who transmits when.
explanation_hi: MAC sub-layer का मुख्य काम channel (medium) तक पहुँच नियंत्रित करना है — कब कौन भेजेगा.
nukta_en: MAC = addressing + channel access; पर परीक्षा में 'primary function' = channel access.
nukta_hi: MAC = addressing + channel access; पर परीक्षा में 'primary function' = channel access.

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: Which protocol requires time synchronization among nodes?
stem_hi: किस protocol में nodes के बीच time synchronization चाहिए होती है?
explanation_en: In Slotted ALOHA, time is divided into slots and transmission starts only at a slot boundary — so all nodes must be synchronised.
explanation_hi: Slotted ALOHA में time को slots में बाँटा जाता है और transmission सिर्फ slot की शुरुआत में होती है — इसलिए सभी nodes synchronized होने चाहिए.
nukta_en: Pure ALOHA = send whenever you like; Slotted = send only when the slot clock says so.
nukta_hi: Pure ALOHA = जब मन चाहे भेजो; Slotted = slot की घड़ी देखकर भेजो.

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: The vulnerable period of Pure ALOHA is:
stem_hi: Pure ALOHA का vulnerable period होता है:
explanation_en: Pure ALOHA में कोई भी frame T समय तक टकरा सकता है — vulnerable period 2T होता है (इसीलिए efficiency G·e⁻²ᴳ, अधिकतम ~18.4%).
explanation_hi: Pure ALOHA में कोई भी frame T समय तक टकरा सकता है — vulnerable period 2T होता है (इसीलिए efficiency G·e⁻²ᴳ, अधिकतम ~18.4%).
nukta_en: Pure ALOHA: 2T और G·e⁻²ᴳ (~18.4%); Slotted ALOHA: T और G·e⁻ᴳ (~36.8%).
nukta_hi: Pure ALOHA: 2T और G·e⁻²ᴳ (~18.4%); Slotted ALOHA: T और G·e⁻ᴳ (~36.8%).

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: In a slotted ALOHA with G stations attempting to transmit in one slot, the throughput is equal to:

explanation_en: Split horizon (don't advertise a route back where you learned it) and poison reverse (declare the route as 16 hops) — both are loop-stopping techniques.

explanation_en: In distance vector protocols, bad news keeps circulating among neighbours and hop counts keep rising — this is the count-to-infinity problem.
explanation_hi: Distance vector protocols में गलत जानकारी पड़ोसियों से गोल-गोल घूमती रहती है और hop counts बढ़ते जाते हैं — यही count-to-infinity समस्या है.
nukta_en: Count-to-infinity is the signature of DV; link-state is free of it (but uses more memory).

stem_en: Suppose the stop-and-wait protocol is used on a link with a bit rate of 64 kilobits per second and 20 milliseconds propagation delay. stem_en:
Consider the following statements regarding the slow start phase of TCP congestion control (cwnd = congestion window, MSS = maximum segment size):
(i) cwnd increases by 2 MSS on every successful acknowledgement.
(ii) cwnd approximately doubles on every successful acknowledgement.
(iii) cwnd increases by 1 MSS every round trip time.
(iv) cwnd approximately doubles every round trip time.
Which one of the following is correct?
stem_hi:
TCP congestion control के slow start चरण (cwnd = congestion window, MSS = maximum segment size) के बारे में विचार कीजिए:
(i) हर successful acknowledgement पर cwnd 2 MSS बढ़ता है।
(ii) हर successful acknowledgement पर cwnd लगभग दोगुना होता है।
(iii) हर round trip time में cwnd 1 MSS बढ़ता है।
(iv) हर round trip time में cwnd लगभग दोगुना होता है।
क्या सही है?
explanation_en: Slow start mein har ACK par cwnd 1 MSS badhta hai; RTT mein cwnd/MSS ACKs aate hain — isliye per RTT cwnd double hota hai: sirf (iv) sahi hai.
explanation_hi: Slow start में हर ACK पर cwnd +1 MSS; एक RTT में cwnd/MSS ACKs — इसलिए per RTT double: केवल (iv) सही।
nukta_en: Per-ACK doubling (ii) bahut tez hota; (iii) per-RTT sirf 1 MSS congestion avoidance jaisa hai.
nukta_hi: Per-ACK doubling (ii) असंभव-सा; (iii) तो congestion avoidance जैसा।

stem_en: A client opens a TCP connection to a web server on port 80 using source port 49152. What is the complete socket pair?
stem_hi: एक client source port 49152 से port 80 वाले web server को TCP connection खोलता है. पूरा socket pair क्या होगा?
explanation_en: Socket pair में पहले जोड़े में client का IP:Port और दूसरे में server का IP:Port होता है — client:49152 ↔ server:80.
explanation_hi: Socket pair में पहले जोड़े में client का IP:Port और दूसरे में server का IP:Port होता है — client:49152 ↔ server:80.
nukta_en: पहचान: client का port ephemeral (बड़ा number), server का port well-known (80).
nukta_hi: पहचान: client का port ephemeral (बड़ा number), server का port well-known (80).

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: What is the purpose of the SYN flag in TCP?
stem_hi: TCP में SYN flag का उद्देश्य क्या है?
explanation_en: TCP connection शुरू करने के लिए तीन-तरफ़ा handshake (SYN → SYN-ACK → ACK) होता है — SYN यही connection request है.
explanation_hi: TCP connection शुरू करने के लिए तीन-तरफ़ा handshake (SYN → SYN-ACK → ACK) होता है — SYN यही connection request है.
nukta_en: Remember the flags: SYN = start; FIN = end; RST = abort; ACK = confirmation.
nukta_hi: Flags याद रखो: SYN = शुरुआत; FIN = अंत; RST = रद्द; ACK = पुष्टि.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: The three-way handshake mechanism in TCP aims to:
stem_hi: TCP का three-way handshake mechanism किस उद्देश्य से होता है?

options.text_en: Send bits from one device to another
options.text_hi: Send bits from one device to another

options.text_en: Establish a connection and synchronize sequence numbers
options.text_hi: Establish a connection and synchronize sequence numbers

explanation_en: The three-way handshake sets up the connection at both ends and exchanges sequence numbers (synchronisation).
explanation_hi: तीन-तरफ़ा handshake से दोनों तरफ़ connection बनती है और sequence numbers का आदान-प्रदान होता है (सिंक्रोनाइज़ेशन).
nukta_en: unverified supplied answer-table claim. SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK — तीन ही संदेश.
nukta_hi: unverified supplied answer-table claim. SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK — तीन ही संदेश.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: In which scenario will TCP's three-way handshake fail?
stem_hi: किस स्थिति में TCP का three-way handshake विफल होगा?
explanation_en: If a firewall blocks the SYN-ACK, the handshake never completes and no connection is made.
explanation_hi: यदि firewall SYN-ACK को रोक दे तो handshake पूरा नहीं होता और connection नहीं बनती.
nukta_en: The immediate cause of a failed handshake: the messages are not getting through (firewall/filter).
nukta_hi: Handshake टूटने का सीधा कारण: संदेशों का न पहुँचना (firewall/filter).

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: In TCP, which state follows the SYN-SENT state in the normal case?
stem_hi: TCP में सामान्य स्थिति में SYN-SENT के बाद कौन-सी state आती है?
explanation_en: SYN भेजने (SYN-SENT) के बाद जब SYN-ACK आता है और ACK भेजा जाता है, connection ESTABLISHED हो जाती है.
explanation_hi: SYN भेजने (SYN-SENT) के बाद जब SYN-ACK आता है और ACK भेजा जाता है, connection ESTABLISHED हो जाती है.
nukta_en: सामान्य क्रम: CLOSED → SYN-SENT → ESTABLISHED. (Simultaneous open में SYN-RECEIVED बीच में आती है.)
nukta_hi: सामान्य क्रम: CLOSED → SYN-SENT → ESTABLISHED. (Simultaneous open में SYN-RECEIVED बीच में आती है.)

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which one of the following attacks exploits TCP's three-way handshake?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा attack TCP के three-way handshake का फ़ायदा उठाती है?
explanation_en: SYN Flood में attacker ढेरों SYN भेजकर half-open connections बना देता है और server के resources खत्म हो जाते हैं.
explanation_hi: SYN Flood में attacker ढेरों SYN भेजकर half-open connections बना देता है और server के resources खत्म हो जाते हैं.
nukta_en: Handshake पर हमला = SYN flood; sequence पर हमला = session hijacking.
nukta_hi: Handshake पर हमला = SYN flood; sequence पर हमला = session hijacking.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: What type of attack is prevented by using random initial sequence numbers in TCP?
stem_hi: TCP में random initial sequence numbers उपयोग करने से किस प्रकार की attack रुकती है?
explanation_en: Random sequence numbers से attacker अगला sequence number अनुमान नहीं लगा पाता और session hijacking (और spoofed ACK) रुकती है.
explanation_hi: Random sequence numbers से attacker अगला sequence number अनुमान नहीं लगा पाता और session hijacking (और spoofed ACK) रुकती है.
nukta_en: Predictable sequence numbers = session hijacking का दरवाज़ा.
nukta_hi: Predictable sequence numbers = session hijacking का दरवाज़ा.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which field in the TCP header is used for flow control?
stem_hi: TCP header में flow control के लिए कौन-सा field उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: Window Size field बताता है कि receiver कितने bytes और ले सकता है — यही TCP का flow control है.
explanation_hi: Window Size field बताता है कि receiver कितने bytes और ले सकता है — यही TCP का flow control है.
nukta_en: TCP के दो घरेलू नियंत्रण: Window (flow control) और cwnd (congestion control).
nukta_hi: TCP के दो घरेलू नियंत्रण: Window (flow control) और cwnd (congestion control).

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which TCP header field ensures that data arrives in order?
stem_hi: TCP header का कौन-सा field सुनिश्चित करता है कि data क्रम में पहुँचे?
explanation_en: Every byte has a sequence number — the receiver uses them to put the bytes back in the correct order.
explanation_hi: हर byte का sequence number होता है — receiver इन्हीं से bytes को सही क्रम में जोड़ता है.
nukta_en: UDP has no sequence numbers — that is why it gives no ordering guarantee.
nukta_hi: UDP में sequence नहीं होता — इसीलिए वहाँ क्रम की guarantee नहीं.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which field in the TCP header ensures data integrity?
stem_hi: TCP header का कौन-सा field data integrity सुनिश्चित करता है?
explanation_en: The checksum sums the whole segment to verify integrity — if anything changed on the way, the packet is dropped.
explanation_hi: Checksum पूरे segment का जोड़ निकालकर integrity जाँचता है — रास्ते में कुछ बदला तो packet छोड़ दिया जाता है.
nukta_en: Integrity = Checksum (TCP/UDP/IP); reliability = ACK + retransmission.
nukta_hi: Integrity = Checksum (TCP/UDP/IP); reliability = ACK + retransmission.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which of the following is NOT a property of TCP?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा TCP का गुण नहीं है?
explanation_en: TCP point-to-point reliable protocol है — broadcast/multicast नहीं करता. Broadcast का काम UDP/UDP-lite जैसे protocols करते हैं.
explanation_hi: TCP point-to-point reliable protocol है — broadcast/multicast नहीं करता. Broadcast का काम UDP/UDP-lite जैसे protocols करते हैं.
nukta_en: TCP = reliable + ordered + connection-oriented; बाकी सब (broadcast) UDP की तरफ़ जाता है.
nukta_hi: TCP = reliable + ordered + connection-oriented; बाकी सब (broadcast) UDP की तरफ़ जाता है.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which of the following provides reliable, connection-oriented communication?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा भरोसेमंद, connection-oriented communication देता है?
explanation_en: TCP ही reliable और connection-oriented transport protocol है.
explanation_hi: TCP ही reliable और connection-oriented transport protocol है.
nukta_en: याद रखो: TCP = phone call (connection + guarantee); UDP = postcard (fast, no promise).
nukta_hi: याद रखो: TCP = phone call (connection + guarantee); UDP = postcard (fast, no promise).

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: TCP initially uses which congestion control technique when a connection starts?
stem_hi: Connection शुरू होने पर TCP शुरू में कौन-सी congestion control technique उपयोग करता है?
explanation_en: At connection start TCP uses Slow Start — the congestion window is kept small and increased gradually.
explanation_hi: Connection शुरू में TCP Slow start उपयोग करता है — congestion window छोटा रखकर धीरे-धीरे बढ़ाया जाता है.
nukta_en: TCP क्रम: Slow start → Congestion avoidance; loss पर → Fast recovery.
nukta_hi: TCP क्रम: Slow start → Congestion avoidance; loss पर → Fast recovery.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: What is the purpose of TCP's congestion window (cwnd)?
stem_hi: TCP के congestion window (cwnd) का उद्देश्य क्या है?

options.text_en: Control the sending rate to avoid network congestion
options.text_hi: Control the sending rate to avoid network congestion

explanation_en: cwnd controls the sender's speed according to network capacity — it shrinks on loss and grows when all is well.
explanation_hi: cwnd network की क्षमता के हिसाब से sender की गति नियंत्रित करता है — ज़्यादा loss हो तो घटता है, सब ठीक हो तो बढ़ता है.
nukta_en: TCP की effective window = min(rwnd, cwnd) — flow और congestion दोनों का संतुलन.
nukta_hi: TCP की effective window = min(rwnd, cwnd) — flow और congestion दोनों का संतुलन.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: What kind of delay does TCP's window size help handle on a long, high-bandwidth path?
stem_hi: लंबी, high-bandwidth path पर TCP का window size किस प्रकार की देर संभालने में मदद करता है?
explanation_en: The bigger the Bandwidth × Delay (BDP), the bigger the window must be — only then is the pipe full and propagation delay hidden.
explanation_hi: Bandwidth × Delay (BDP) जितना बड़ा हो, window उतनी बड़ी चाहिए — तभी पूरी pipe भरी रहती है और propagation delay छिप जाता है.
nukta_en: Window ≥ BDP हो तो link बेकार नहीं बैठती — यही high-speed long links का सूत्र है.
nukta_hi: Window ≥ BDP हो तो link बेकार नहीं बैठती — यही high-speed long links का सूत्र है.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: In which protocol is 'port knocking' used as a security mechanism?
stem_hi: किस protocol में 'port knocking' security mechanism के रूप में उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: In port knocking, connection attempts hit closed ports in a fixed sequence, after which the firewall opens a service like SSH — often used with SSH servers.
explanation_hi: Port knocking में बंद ports पर तय क्रम से connection attempts किए जाते हैं, जिसके बाद firewall SSH जैसी सेवा खोल देता है — यह अक्सर SSH servers के साथ उपयोग होता है.
nukta_en: Port knocking = 'secret door knock' — पहचान होते ही असली दरवाज़ा (SSH) खुलता है.
nukta_hi: Port knocking = 'secret door knock' — पहचान होते ही असली दरवाज़ा (SSH) खुलता है.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which of the following supports QoS (Quality of Service) through label switching?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा label switching के ज़रिए QoS (Quality of Service) देता है?
explanation_en: MPLS divides traffic into classes using labels and provides QoS — routers don't repeatedly inspect the full IP header.
explanation_hi: MPLS labels के ज़रिए traffic को classes में बाँटकर QoS देता है — routers बार-बार पूरा IP header नहीं देखते.
nukta_en: MPLS = fast path + QoS classes; DiffServ/IntServ भी QoS के तरीके हैं.
nukta_hi: MPLS = fast path + QoS classes; DiffServ/IntServ भी QoS के तरीके हैं.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Virtual circuits are associated with which type of service?
stem_hi: Virtual circuits किस प्रकार की service से जुड़े हैं?
explanation_en: Virtual circuit (जैसे X.25, ATM, Frame Relay) में पहले रास्ता तय होता है, फिर सारे packets उसी रास्ते से जाते हैं — यह connection-oriented model है.
explanation_hi: Virtual circuit (जैसे X.25, ATM, Frame Relay) में पहले रास्ता तय होता है, फिर सारे packets उसी रास्ते से जाते हैं — यह connection-oriented model है.
nukta_en: Virtual circuit = पहले connection, फिर data (connection-oriented); Datagram = हर packet अपने-आप (connectionless).
nukta_hi: Virtual circuit = पहले connection, फिर data (connection-oriented); Datagram = हर packet अपने-आप (connectionless).

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Transport layer multiplexing allows:
stem_hi: Transport layer multiplexing की अनुमति देता है:

options.text_en: Multiple hosts to share one IP
options.text_hi: Multiple hosts to share one IP

options.text_en: Multiple processes to share one network connection
options.text_hi: Multiple processes to share one network connection

options.text_en: Multiple routers to share a routing table
options.text_hi: Multiple routers to share a routing table

explanation_en: Transport layer multiplexing/demultiplexing से एक ही IP connection पर कई applications (processes) अपने-अपने ports से चल सकते हैं.
explanation_hi: Transport layer multiplexing/demultiplexing से एक ही IP connection पर कई applications (processes) अपने-अपने ports से चल सकते हैं.
nukta_en: Ports ही multiplexing के हथियार हैं — browser 443, mail 25, सब एक साथ.
nukta_hi: Ports ही multiplexing के हथियार हैं — browser 443, mail 25, सब एक साथ.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which protocol must use both TCP and UDP for different operations?
stem_hi: कौन-सा protocol अलग-अलग कामों के लिए TCP और UDP दोनों उपयोग करता है?
explanation_en: DNS queries usually travel on UDP (port 53), but large transfers and zone transfers use TCP — so DNS uses both.
explanation_hi: DNS queries आमतौर पर UDP (port 53) पर जाती हैं, पर बड़े transfers और zone transfers TCP पर — इसलिए DNS दोनों उपयोग करता है.
nukta_en: DNS = port 53; UDP for small queries, TCP for big/zone transfers.
nukta_hi: DNS = port 53; UDP for small queries, TCP for big/zone transfers.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which port is used by a DHCP client when requesting an IP address?
stem_hi: IP address माँगते समय DHCP client कौन-सा port उपयोग करता है?
explanation_en: DHCP client UDP port 68 से request भेजता है और server UDP port 67 से जवाब देता है.
explanation_hi: DHCP client UDP port 68 से request भेजता है और server UDP port 67 से जवाब देता है.
nukta_en: जोड़ी याद रखो: server 67, client 68 — DHCP (UDP).
nukta_hi: जोड़ी याद रखो: server 67, client 68 — DHCP (UDP).

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which transport-layer protocol is used to support electronic mail delivery between machines?
stem_hi: Machines के बीच electronic mail delivery के लिए कौन-सा transport-layer protocol उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: Mail की सेवा SMTP (application) देती है, पर वह अपना data TCP के ज़रिए ही भेजती है — इसलिए transport layer पर TCP.
explanation_hi: Mail की सेवा SMTP (application) देती है, पर वह अपना data TCP के ज़रिए ही भेजता है — इसलिए transport layer पर TCP.
nukta_en: प्रश्न 'transport-layer protocol' पूछ रहा है — SMTP application layer का है, TCP transport का.
nukta_hi: प्रश्न 'transport-layer protocol' पूछ रहा है — SMTP application layer का है, TCP transport का.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which of the following statements about TCP/IP is INCORRECT?
stem_hi: TCP/IP के बारे में निम्न में से कौन-सा कथन गलत है?

options.text_en: Data packets sent over TCP/IP are private
options.text_hi: Data packets sent over TCP/IP are private

options.text_en: TCP is used by Secure Shell (SSH)
options.text_hi: TCP is used by Secure Shell (SSH)

options.text_en: TCP/IP uses checksums to check errors
options.text_hi: TCP/IP uses checksums to check errors

explanation_en: Packets on TCP/IP are not private by nature — they can be seen on the way; for confidentiality you must add TLS/SSH/VPN.
explanation_hi: TCP/IP पर भेजे packets स्वाभाविक रूप से private नहीं होते — रास्ते में देखे जा सकते हैं; गोपनीयता के लिए TLS/SSH/VPN लगाना पड़ता है.
nukta_en: DSSSB का official key (b). याद रखो: Internet = open postcard, ताला (encryption) खुद लगाओ.
nukta_hi: DSSSB का official key (b). याद रखो: Internet = open postcard, ताला (encryption) खुद लगाओ.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Why are port numbers included in the TCP header of a segment?
stem_hi: Segment के TCP header में port numbers क्यों रखे जाते हैं?

options.text_en: To indicate the correct router interface for forwarding
options.text_hi: To indicate the correct router interface for forwarding

options.text_en: To identify which switch ports should receive the frame
options.text_hi: To identify which switch ports should receive the frame

options.text_en: To determine which Layer 3 protocol encapsulates the data
options.text_hi: To determine which Layer 3 protocol encapsulates the data

options.text_en: To enable a receiving host to forward the data to the appropriate application
options.text_hi: To enable a receiving host to forward the data to the appropriate application

explanation_en: Port numbers बताते हैं कि receiver पर data किस application (process) को देना है — इसीलिए एक ही connection पर कई apps चल सकते हैं.
explanation_hi: Port numbers बताते हैं कि receiver पर data किस application (process) को देना है — इसीलिए एक ही connection पर कई apps चल सकते हैं.
nukta_en: RPSC 2011 official key (4). यही transport-layer multiplexing है.
nukta_hi: RPSC 2011 official key (4). यही transport-layer multiplexing है.

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which one of the following fields of an IP header is NOT modified by a typical IP router?
stem_hi: IP header का कौन-सा field एक सामान्य IP router द्वारा संशोधित नहीं किया जाता?
explanation_en: Router TTL ko ghatata hai, checksum phir se calculate karta hai, fragmentation par length badal sakti hai — par source address hamesha wahi rehta hai (GATE 2015 key).
explanation_hi: Router TTL घटाता है, checksum नया, fragmentation पर length बदल सकती है — source address वही रहता है (GATE 2015 key).
nukta_en: Checksum aur TTL router ke haath badalte hain; length fragmentation se badal sakti hai.
nukta_hi: Checksum/TTL बदलते हैं; length fragmentation से बदल सकती है।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which of the following fields of an IP header is/are ALWAYS modified by any router before it forwards the IP packet?
stem_hi: IP packet forward करने से पहले हर router IP header के कौन-से fields हमेशा बदलता है?
explanation_en: Har hop par TTL ghat-ta hai (1 kam) aur uske kaaran header checksum bhi har router ko phir se lagana hi padta hai — dono always modified hote hain.
explanation_hi: हर hop पर TTL घटता है और उससे header checksum भी हर router को नया करना पड़ता है — दोनों हमेशा बदलते हैं।
nukta_en: Checksum ko optional samajhna galti hai — TTL badalne par checksum invalid ho jata hai.
nukta_hi: Checksum optional नहीं — TTL बदलते ही checksum अमान्य हो जाता है।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which of the following fields is/are modified in the IP header of a packet going out of a Network Address Translation (NAT) device from an internal network to an external network?
stem_hi: NAT device से internal network से external network की तरफ़ जाते packet के IP header में कौन-से fields बदले जाते हैं?

options.text_en: Source IP address and header checksum
options.text_hi: Source IP address और header checksum

explanation_en: NAT bahar jaate packet ka private source IP apne public IP se badalta hai (aur mapping banaata hai); us badalav se header checksum bhi recompute hota hai.
explanation_hi: NAT बाहर जाते packet का private source IP अपने public IP से बदलता है; उससे header checksum भी नया होता है।
nukta_en: Destination address wahi rehta hai (jana to server ko hi hai); TTL alag cheez hai.
nukta_hi: Destination वही रहता है; TTL अलग चीज़ है।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Consider sending an IP datagram of size 1420 bytes (including a 20-byte IP header) over a path of two links with a router between them. The first link has MTU 542 bytes and the second link has MTU 360 bytes. The number of fragments delivered at the receiver is ______.
stem_hi: 1420 bytes का IP datagram (20-byte header सहित) दो links के रास्ते भेजा जा रहा है, बीच में एक router है। पहले link का MTU 542 bytes और दूसरे का 360 bytes है। Receiver पर कुल कितने fragments पहुँचेंगे?
explanation_en: 1400 bytes data पहले link पर 3 fragments (522, 522, 356); दूसरे link (340 bytes data per fragment) पर हर बड़ा fragment 2 में टूटता है — कुल 2+2+2 = 6 fragments.
explanation_hi: 1400 bytes data पहले link पर 3 (522, 522, 356); दूसरे link पर (340 data) हर बड़ा 2 में — कुल 6.
nukta_en: 5/8 fragmentation ko sirf ek baar maante hain; 4 total data ko 360 se seedha bhaag dete hain.
nukta_hi: 5/8 fragmentation एक ही बार मानते हैं; 4 सीधे 360 से भाग देते हैं।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: In an IPv4 datagram, the M bit is 0, the value of HLEN is 10, the value of total length is 400 and the fragment offset value is 300. The position of the datagram, and the sequence numbers of the first and the last bytes of the payload, respectively, are:
stem_hi: एक IPv4 datagram में M bit = 0, HLEN = 10, total length = 400 और fragment offset = 300 है। इस datagram की स्थिति तथा payload के पहले और आख़िरी bytes के sequence numbers क्रमशः हैं:
explanation_en: HLEN 10 → header 40 bytes; offset 300 × 8 = 2400 se payload shuru; payload 400−40 = 360 bytes → aakhri byte 2400+359 = 2759; M = 0 matlab yeh aakhri fragment hai.
explanation_hi: HLEN 10 → header 40 bytes; offset 300×8 = 2400 से payload; 400−40 = 360 bytes → आख़िरी byte 2759; M = 0 = यही अंतिम fragment है।
nukta_en: Offset ko byte nahi 8-byte units mein count karna zaroori hai; 2779 header ko do baar jod deta hai.
nukta_hi: Offset 8-byte units में होता है; 2779 header दो बार जोड़ता है।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en:
Consider the following three statements about link state and distance vector routing protocols for a large network with 500 nodes and 4000 links:
S1: The computational overhead in link state protocols is higher than in distance vector protocols.
S2: A distance vector protocol (with split horizon) avoids persistent routing loops, but a link state protocol does not.
S3: After a topology change, a link state protocol converges faster than a distance vector protocol.
Which one is correct?
stem_hi:
500 nodes और 4000 links वाले बड़े network के लिए link state व distance vector routing protocols के बारे में तीन कथन:
S1: Link state में computational overhead distance vector से अधिक है।
S2: Distance vector (split horizon सहित) persistent loops से बचता है, पर link state नहीं।
S3: Topology बदलने पर link state, distance vector से तेज़ converge करता है।
कौन-सा सही है?

options.text_en: S1, S2 and S3 are all true
S1, S2 and S3 are all false
S1 and S2 are true, S3 is false
options.text_hi: S1 और S2 सही, S3 गलत

options.text_en: S1 and S3 are true, S2 is false
options.text_hi: S1 और S3 सही, S2 गलत

explanation_en: S1 sahi: har node poora SPF/Dijkstra chalata hai. S3 sahi: flooding se LS topology turant jaanti hai. S2 galat: link state shortest-path tree loop-free hota hai — loops ki samasya distance vector ki hai.
explanation_hi: S1 सही: हर node पूरा SPF चलाता है। S3 सही: flooding से तेज़ converge। S2 गलत: link state tree loop-free होता है।
nukta_en: S2 ulta hai — split horizon count-to-infinity se poora bachata bhi nahi.
nukta_hi: S2 उल्टा — split horizon count-to-infinity से पूरा बचाता भी नहीं।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: Which one of the following is TRUE about the interior gateway routing protocols RIP (Routing Information Protocol) and OSPF (Open Shortest Path First)?
stem_hi: Interior gateway routing protocols RIP (Routing Information Protocol) और OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?

options.text_en: RIP uses distance vector routing and OSPF uses link state routing
options.text_hi: RIP distance vector और OSPF link state routing प्रयोग करता है

options.text_en: OSPF uses distance vector routing and RIP uses link state routing
options.text_hi: OSPF distance vector और RIP link state routing प्रयोग करता है

options.text_en: Both RIP and OSPF use link state routing
options.text_hi: दोनों link state routing प्रयोग करते हैं

options.text_en: Both RIP and OSPF use distance vector routing
options.text_hi: दोनों distance vector routing प्रयोग करते हैं

explanation_en: RIP neighbours ko apni distance vector bhejta hai (distance vector family); OSPF poora topology map flood kar Dijkstra chalata hai (link state) — yeh standard classification hai.
explanation_hi: RIP अपनी distance vector भेजता है; OSPF topology flood कर Dijkstra चलाता है (link state) — यही मानक भेद है।
nukta_en: Dono ko ek hi category mein daalna common galti hai.
nukta_hi: दोनों को एक श्रेणी में डालना आम गलती।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en:
Consider the following statements about the functionality of an IP based router:
I. A router does not modify the IP packets during forwarding.
II. It is not necessary for a router to implement any routing protocol.
III. A router should reassemble IP fragments if the MTU of the outgoing link is larger than the size of the incoming IP packet.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are TRUE?
stem_hi:
IP आधारित router की कार्यप्रणाली के बारे में विचार:
I. Router forwarding के दौरान IP packets को संशोधित नहीं करता।
II. Router के लिए कोई routing protocol लागू करना आवश्यक नहीं है।
III. यदि outgoing link का MTU आने वाले packet से बड़ा हो तो router को fragments जोड़ने चाहिए।
इनमें कौन-सा कथन सही है?
explanation_en: I galat: router TTL ghatata hai aur checksum badalta hai. II sahi: static routes se bhi router chal sakta hai. III galat: reassembly sirf destination host karta hai, router kabhi nahi.
explanation_hi: I गलत: router TTL/checksum बदलता है। II सही: static routes से भी चलेगा। III गलत: reassembly सिर्फ़ destination करता है।
nukta_en: Fragmentation ke baad re-fragmentation ka kaam router ka hai, jodna nahi.
nukta_hi: Router re-fragment कर सकता है, जोड़ता नहीं।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en:
Host A (on TCP/IPv4 network A) sends an IP datagram D to host B (on TCP/IPv4 network B) with no transmission error. When D reaches B, which of the following IP header field(s) may be different from that of the original datagram D?
I. TTL    II. Checksum    III. Fragment Offset
stem_hi:
Host A ने (TCP/IPv4 network A से) बिना किसी त्रुटि के IP datagram D, host B को भेजा। D के B पर पहुँचने पर निम्न में से कौन-से IP header fields मूल datagram से भिन्न हो सकते हैं?
I. TTL    II. Checksum    III. Fragment Offset
explanation_en: Har router par TTL ghat-ta hai aur checksum naya hota hai; raaste mein fragmentation hui to fragment offset bhi lag sakta hai — teeno badal sakte hain (GATE 2014 key).
explanation_hi: हर router पर TTL घटता है, checksum नया; रास्ते में fragmentation हुई तो offset भी — तीनों बदल सकते हैं।
nukta_en: Offset ko 'sirf fragmentation ke time' samajh kar chhod dena galti hai — puchha hai 'ho sakta hai'.
nukta_hi: Offset को छोड़ देना गलती — पूछा है 'हो सकता है'।

subtopic: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
stem_en: Which protocol layer uses protocols such as WWW, HTTP, FTP, SMTP and e-mail?
stem_hi: कौन-सी protocol layer WWW, HTTP, FTP, SMTP और e-mail जैसे protocols उपयोग करती है?
explanation_en: HTTP, FTP, SMTP, e-mail आदि Application layer के protocols हैं — यही उपयोगकर्ता की सेवाएँ देती हैं.
explanation_hi: HTTP, FTP, SMTP, e-mail आदि Application layer के protocols हैं — यही उपयोगकर्ता की सेवाएँ देती हैं.
nukta_en: याद रखो: Layer 7 = सेवाएँ (HTTP/FTP/SMTP/DNS); Layer 4 = TCP/UDP; Layer 3 = IP.
nukta_hi: याद रखो: Layer 7 = सेवाएँ (HTTP/FTP/SMTP/DNS); Layer 4 = TCP/UDP; Layer 3 = IP.

explanation_hi: Layer 7 (Application) ही users की सेवाएँ संभालती है — passwords, file transfer, resource sharing आदि.

nukta_en: HTTP = multi-connection capable; FTP = दो का जोड़ा; 'only two' का नियम कहीं नहीं.

subtopic: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
stem_en: Consider a long-lived TCP session with an end-to-end bandwidth of 1 Gbps (= 10⁹ bits/second). The session starts with a sequence number of 1234. The minimum time (in seconds, rounded to the closest integer) before this sequence number can be used again is ______.
stem_hi: एक लंबी TCP session की bandwidth 1 Gbps (= 10⁹ bits/second) है और वह sequence number 1234 से शुरू होती है। इस sequence number के पुनः प्रयोग से पहले न्यूनतम समय (seconds में, निकटतम पूर्णांक) कितना है?
explanation_en: TCP sequence numbers bytes count karte hain: 2³² bytes ka space; 1 Gbps = 1.25×10⁸ bytes/sec → 2³² ÷ 1.25×10⁸ = 34.36 s → 34 second.
explanation_hi: TCP sequence numbers bytes गिनते हैं: 2³² bytes; 1 Gbps = 1.25×10⁸ B/s → 34.36 s → 34 second.
nukta_en: Bits mein hisaab karke 4 s; ya 2³² bits samajh kar galat number — bytes ka chakkar hai.
nukta_hi: Bits में हिसाब लगाना (4 s) या 2³² bits मानना गलत।

subtopic: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
stem_en: In the TCP three-way handshake, host P sends a connection request to Q with SYN = 1, SEQ = X, ACK = 0. Q accepts the connection. Which of the following represents the information in the TCP segment header sent by Q to P?
stem_hi: TCP three-way handshake में host P, Q को connection request भेजता है: SYN = 1, SEQ = X, ACK = 0। Q connection स्वीकार करता है। Q द्वारा P को भेजे segment header में क्या होगा?
explanation_en: Q apna random sequence number Y bhejta hai, SYN=1 rakhta hai (apna SYN), aur acknowledge karta hai X ka — agla byte X+1 (GATE 2021 key: III).
explanation_hi: Q अपना sequence number Y भेजता है, SYN=1, और X का ack = X+1 (GATE 2021 key: III)।
nukta_en: ACK = X galat (yeh khud ko X+1 expect karna hua); SYN=0 second segment jaisa hota.
nukta_hi: ACK = X गलत (X+1 अपेक्षित); SYN=0 दूसरे जैसा।

subtopic: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
stem_en: Consider data transfer using TCP over a 1 Gbps link. Assuming that the maximum segment lifetime (MSL) is set to 60 seconds, the minimum number of bits required for the sequence number field of the TCP header, to prevent the sequence number space from wrapping around during the MSL, is ______.
stem_hi: 1 Gbps link पर TCP से data transfer हो रहा है। Maximum segment lifetime (MSL) 60 seconds है। MSL के दौरान sequence number space के wrap होने से बचने के लिए TCP header के sequence number field में न्यूनतम कितने bits चाहिए?
explanation_en: 1 Gbps = 1.25×10⁸ bytes/sec; 60 s में 7.5×10⁹ bytes; 2³² = 4.29×10⁹ < 7.5×10⁹ < 2³³ = 8.59×10⁹ — इसलिए कम से कम 33 bits (GATE 2022 key).
nukta_en: 32 bits mein space 60 s के लिए kam padta hai; 34/36 zyada hain (minimum pucha hai).
nukta_hi: 32 कम पड़ता; 34/36 ज़्यादा (न्यूनतम पूछा है)।

subtopic: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
stem_en: A TCP client and server complete data transfer. The client calls close; a FIN segment is sent to the server, which responds with an ACK received by the client. As per the TCP connection state diagram (RFC 793), in which state does the client-side TCP connection wait for the FIN from the server?
stem_hi: TCP client-server का data transfer पूरा हुआ। Client close करता है; server को FIN जाता है; server का ACK client को मिलता है। RFC 793 की state diagram के अनुसार client-side connection server के FIN की प्रतीक्षा किस state में करती है?
explanation_en: Client: FIN_WAIT_1 (FIN bheja) → ACK mila → FIN_WAIT_2 (server ke FIN ka intezar) → phir TIME_WAIT. CLOSE_WAIT server-side hoti hai.
explanation_hi: Client: FIN_WAIT_1 (FIN भेजा) → ACK मिला → FIN_WAIT_2 (server के FIN का इंतज़ार) → फिर TIME_WAIT. CLOSE_WAIT server-side।
nukta_en: TIME_WAIT aakhri state hai (dono FIN ke baad); CLOSE_WAIT server ki hoti hai.
nukta_hi: TIME_WAIT अंत में; CLOSE_WAIT server की।

stem_en: In Selective Repeat ARQ, when a frame is corrupted, the sender retransmits:
stem_hi: Selective Repeat ARQ में frame ख़राब होने पर दोबारा भेजता है:
explanation_en: Selective Repeat = sirf galat frame; Go-Back-N = uske aage ke sab.
explanation_hi: Selective Repeat = सिर्फ़ ख़राब; Go-Back-N = आगे के सब।
nukta_en: Go-Back-N sab dobara bhejta hai.
nukta_hi: Go-Back-N सब दोबारा।

subtopic: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
stem_en: Parity check can detect which type of errors?
stem_hi: Parity check कौन-सी errors detect कर सकता है?
explanation_en: Single parity bit odd-bit errors detect karta hai; even ko miss.
explanation_hi: Parity bit विषम-bit errors detect करती है।
nukta_en: CRC burst errors ke liye behtar.
nukta_hi: CRC burst के लिए बेहतर।

subtopic: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
stem_en: Forward Error Correction (FEC) differs from ARQ in that:
stem_hi: Forward Error Correction (FEC), ARQ से भिन्न है क्योंकि:

options.text_en: The receiver corrects errors without retransmission
options.text_hi: Receiver बिना retransmission errors ठीक करता है
यह सिर्फ़ LAN पर चलता है

explanation_en: FEC receiver par hi error correction karta hai — retransmission nahi.
explanation_hi: FEC receiver पर ही ठीक करता है।
nukta_en: ARQ mein retransmission hota hai.
nukta_hi: ARQ में retransmission।

subtopic: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
stem_en: In Go-Back-N ARQ, the receiver's window size is:
stem_hi: Go-Back-N ARQ में receiver की window size होती है:
explanation_en: GBN receiver sirf agla expected frame accept karta hai (window=1); isliye out-of-order frame aaye to use phenk kar pura Go-Back-N retransmission hota hai.
explanation_hi: GBN में receiver सिर्फ अगला expected frame लेता है (window=1); out-of-order आने पर पूरा Go-Back-N।
nukta_en: Selective Repeat mein receiver ki window badi hoti hai — wahi out-of-order frames buffer karta hai.
nukta_hi: Selective Repeat में receiver window बड़ी — out-of-order buffer होते हैं।

subtopic: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
stem_en: Delaying an acknowledgement so that it can be attached to the next outgoing data frame in the reverse direction is called:
stem_hi: Acknowledgement को रोककर विपरीत दिशा में जाने वाले अगले data frame के साथ जोड़ना कहलाता है:
explanation_en: Piggybacking: bidirectional link par ack ko data frame ke saath chipka do — alag ack frame bachta hai, bandwidth bachti hai.
explanation_hi: Piggybacking: bidirectional link पर ack को data frame के साथ जोड़ना — bandwidth बचती है।
nukta_en: Piggybacking mein ack ke liye timer hota hai, taaki der zyada na ho.
nukta_hi: Piggybacking में ack timer होता है, ताकि देर न हो।

subtopic: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
stem_en: Network congestion occurs when:
stem_hi: Network congestion तब होता है जब:

options.text_en: The offered traffic exceeds the network's capacity
options.text_hi: Offered traffic network की क्षमता से अधिक हो

options.text_en: Two hosts use the same port
options.text_hi: दो hosts एक ही port प्रयोग करें

options.text_en: A frame is corrupted by noise

explanation_en: Congestion = queues bhar jaate hain kyunki demand capacity se zyada hai — delay/loss badhte hain. Isi ko sambhalne ke liye congestion control hota hai.
explanation_hi: Congestion = demand क्षमता से अधिक; queues भरती हैं, delay/loss बढ़ता है।
nukta_en: Flow control = receiver ki speed; congestion = network ki capacity.
nukta_hi: Flow control = receiver; congestion = network की क्षमता।

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: In bit stuffing, after how many consecutive 1-bits is a 0 inserted?
stem_hi: Bit stuffing में कितने लगातार 1-bits के बाद 0 जोड़ा जाता है?
explanation_en: Paanch 1s ke baad stuffed 0 (HDLC).
explanation_hi: पाँच 1s के बाद 0 (HDLC)।
nukta_en: 6 wale pattern mein flag hota hai.
nukta_hi: 6 वाला pattern flag है।

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: CSMA/CD is used in:
stem_hi: CSMA/CD प्रयोग होता है:
explanation_en: Wired Ethernet mein collision detect possible — CSMA/CD.
explanation_hi: Wired Ethernet में CSMA/CD।
nukta_en: Wireless mein CSMA/CA.
nukta_hi: Wireless में CSMA/CA।

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: In which access method does a station wait for a free time slot before transmitting?
stem_hi: किस access method में station भेजने से पहले ख़ाली time slot की प्रतीक्षा करता है?
explanation_en: Slotted ALOHA mein sirf slot ke shuruaat par bhej sakte hain.
explanation_hi: Slotted ALOHA में slot की शुरुआत पर।
nukta_en: Pure ALOHA jab mann kare.
nukta_hi: Pure ALOHA जब मन।

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: Token passing is an example of which access method?
stem_hi: Token passing किस access method का उदाहरण है?
explanation_en: Token = controlled access — collision nahi.
explanation_hi: Token = controlled access।
nukta_en: ALOHA/CSMA random hain.
nukta_hi: ALOHA/CSMA random।

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: Which field of the Ethernet frame is used for error detection?
stem_hi: Ethernet frame का कौन-सा field error detection के लिए है?
explanation_en: FCS (Frame Check Sequence) CRC carry karta hai.
explanation_hi: FCS CRC ले जाता है।
nukta_en: Preamble synchronisation ke liye.
nukta_hi: Preamble synchronisation के लिए।

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: Gigabit Ethernet over optical fiber is defined by which IEEE standard?
stem_hi: Optical fiber पर Gigabit Ethernet किस IEEE standard में परिभाषित है?
explanation_en: 802.3z = 1000BASE-X (fiber/STP); 802.3ab = 1000BASE-T (UTP); 802.3u = Fast Ethernet (100 Mbps); 802.3ae = 10 Gbps Ethernet.
explanation_hi: 802.3z = 1000BASE-X (fiber); 802.3ab = 1000BASE-T (UTP); 802.3u = Fast Ethernet; 802.3ae = 10 GbE।
nukta_en: Suffix -T = twisted pair, -X = fiber — standard numbers yaad rakho.
nukta_hi: -T = twisted pair, -X = fiber।

subtopic: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
stem_en: CSMA/CD (collision detection) can be used only when the link operates in:
stem_hi: CSMA/CD (collision detection) तभी प्रयोग हो सकता है जब link चलती हो:
explanation_en: Collision tabhi detect hoti hai jab ek shared medium par dono taraf se traffic aa sake (half-duplex). Full-duplex (alag pairs) mein collisions hote hi nahi — modern Ethernet mein CSMA/CD off hota hai. Pattern: SSC CGL/IBPS + CCNA.
explanation_hi: Collision shared medium (half-duplex) पर ही होती है। Full-duplex में CSMA/CD बंद। Pattern: SSC CGL + CCNA।
nukta_en: Full-duplex = collision-free, isliye minimum frame size ka constraint bhi nahi.
nukta_hi: Full-duplex = collision-free।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: Why is the TTL field decremented at each router?
stem_hi: हर router पर TTL field क्यों घटाया जाता है?

options.text_en: To prevent infinite looping of packets
options.text_hi: Packets के अनंत चक्कर रोकने के लिए

explanation_en: TTL khatam = packet drop (loop prevention).
explanation_hi: TTL ख़त्म = packet drop (loop prevention)।
nukta_en: Encryption/compression ka alag kaam.
nukta_hi: अलग काम।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: An IP datagram of 1000 bytes (20-byte header) is fragmented on a link with MTU 200 bytes. The number of data bytes in the FIRST fragment is:
stem_hi: 1000 bytes का datagram (20-byte header), MTU 200 link पर टूटा। पहले fragment में data bytes होंगे:
explanation_en: MTU 200 = 20 header + 180 data; offset 8 ke multiple mein (180 = 22.5×8 → 176 practical; par standard question mein 180 liya jaata hai — GATE style options 180 hi hote hain).
explanation_hi: MTU 200 − 20 = 180 data पहले fragment में।
nukta_en: 200 poora frame hai.
nukta_hi: 200 पूरा frame है।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: Which routing protocol uses hop count as its metric with a maximum of 15?
stem_hi: कौन-सा routing protocol hop count metric रखता है (अधिकतम 15)?
explanation_en: RIP: hop count, max 15 (16 = infinity).
explanation_hi: RIP: hop count, अधिकतम 15।
nukta_en: OSPF cost use karta hai.
nukta_hi: OSPF cost।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: Ping utility uses which ICMP messages?
stem_hi: Ping utility किस ICMP messages का प्रयोग करती है?
explanation_en: Ping = Echo Request (type 8) + Echo Reply (type 0).
explanation_hi: Ping = Echo Request + Echo Reply।
nukta_en: Time exceeded traceroute mein.
nukta_hi: Time exceeded traceroute में।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: BGP is used for:
stem_hi: BGP प्रयोग होता है:

options.text_hi: एक LAN के अंदर routing के लिए
Autonomous systems के बीच routing के लिए

explanation_en: BGP = inter-AS routing (Internet backbone).
explanation_hi: BGP = inter-AS routing।
nukta_en: RIP/OSPF intra-AS.
nukta_hi: RIP/OSPF intra-AS।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: Congestion control in the network layer is mainly concerned with:
stem_hi: Network layer का congestion control मुख्यतः संबंधित है:

options.text_en: Too many packets in the network
options.text_hi: Network में बहुत अधिक packets से

explanation_en: Congestion = network ke andar traffic overload; flow control = slow receiver.
explanation_hi: Congestion = network overload; flow control = धीमा receiver।
nukta_en: Slow receiver flow control ki samasya hai.
nukta_hi: धीमा receiver = flow control।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: OSPF exchanges routing information directly over IP using IP protocol number:
stem_hi: OSPF routing information IP पर सीधे भेजता है — IP protocol number होता है:
explanation_en: OSPF = IP protocol 89 (na TCP na UDP); BGP = TCP 179; RIP = UDP 520; protocol 6 = TCP.
explanation_hi: OSPF = IP protocol 89 (न TCP न UDP); BGP = TCP 179; RIP = UDP 520।
nukta_en: Ye teen (89/179/520) worldwide exams ke favourite hain.
nukta_hi: ये तीनों (89/179/520) exams के प्रिय प्रश्न हैं।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: BGP, the protocol that routes between autonomous systems on the Internet, uses:
stem_hi: BGP — जो Internet पर autonomous systems के बीच routing करता है — प्रयोग करता है:
explanation_en: BGP = TCP port 179 — reliable transport chahiye Internet-scale routing ke liye.
explanation_hi: BGP = TCP port 179 — Internet-scale routing के लिए reliable transport।
nukta_en: 89 = OSPF; 520 = RIP; 23 = Telnet.
nukta_hi: 89 = OSPF; 520 = RIP; 23 = Telnet।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: The RIP routing protocol uses which transport protocol and port number?
stem_hi: RIP routing protocol कौन-सा transport protocol और port number प्रयोग करता है?
explanation_en: RIP = UDP 520 (chhote periodic updates, reliable transport ki zaroorat nahi).
explanation_hi: RIP = UDP 520 (छोटे periodic updates)।
nukta_en: 161 = SNMP; TCP 89 kuch nahi (OSPF TCP par nahi chalta).
nukta_hi: 161 = SNMP; TCP 89 — कुछ नहीं (OSPF TCP पर नहीं चलता)।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: A router receives a datagram whose TTL becomes 0 after it decrements the field. The router will:
stem_hi: एक router को datagram मिला जिसका TTL घटाने पर 0 हो गया। router क्या करेगा?

options.text_en: Discard the datagram and send an ICMP Time Exceeded message to the source
options.text_hi: Datagram नष्ट करके source को ICMP Time Exceeded भेजेगा

options.text_en: Send it back to the previous router

explanation_en: TTL = routing loops rokne ke liye; har hop par −1, zero hote hi packet gira kar ICMP Time Exceeded (type 11) source ko jaata hai — traceroute isi par chalta hai. Pattern: GATE + RPSC Programmer dono ka favourite.
explanation_hi: TTL हर hop पर −1; 0 होते ही packet गिरकर ICMP Time Exceeded (type 11) जाता है — traceroute इसी पर। Pattern: GATE + RPSC Programmer।
nukta_en: traceroute = TTL 1, 2, 3... karke Time Exceeded ke source routers ka pata.
nukta_hi: traceroute = TTL 1,2,3... से Time Exceeded से routers का पता।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: In OSPF, on a multiaccess network the Designated Router (DR) is the router with:
stem_hi: OSPF में multiaccess network पर Designated Router (DR) होता है वह router जिसके पास:

options.text_en: The highest OSPF interface priority (tie → highest router ID)
options.text_hi: सबसे अधिक OSPF interface priority (बराबरी पर → सबसे बड़ा router ID)

explanation_en: DR election: pehle highest priority (default 1; 0 = kabhi DR nahi), tie par highest router ID. DR adjacency kam karke flooding reduce karta hai. Pattern: CCNA + RPSC ACP/Programmer level.
explanation_hi: DR election: सर्वोच्च priority (default 1), बराबरी पर सबसे बड़ा router ID। Pattern: CCNA + RPSC ACP/Programmer।
nukta_en: OSPF mein 2-way state ke baad DR/BDR election hoti hai.
nukta_hi: OSPF में 2-way के बाद DR/BDR election।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: Two OSPF routers are stuck in the EXSTART/EXCHANGE neighbour state. The most likely cause is:
stem_hi: दो OSPF routers EXSTART/EXCHANGE neighbour state में अटके हैं। सबसे संभावित कारण है:

options.text_en: An MTU mismatch on the connecting interfaces
options.text_hi: जोड़ने वाले interfaces पर MTU का अंतर

explanation_en: Database description (DBD) exchange mein MTU mismatch ke routers EXSTART/EXCHANGE se aage nahi badhte. Process IDs locally significant hote hain — match karne ki zaroorat nahi. Pattern: CCNA troubleshooting + RPSC ACP.
explanation_hi: MTU mismatch से routers EXSTART/EXCHANGE में अटकते हैं। Process IDs locally significant होते हैं। Pattern: CCNA + RPSC ACP।
nukta_en: OSPF states: Down → Init → 2-Way → ExStart → Exchange → Loading → Full.
nukta_hi: OSPF states: Down → Init → 2-Way → ExStart → Exchange → Loading → Full।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: The administrative distance of a static route, an EIGRP route and an OSPF route are respectively:
stem_hi: Static route, EIGRP route और OSPF route का administrative distance क्रमशः होता है:
explanation_en: AD = route ki 'trustworthiness' (kam = zyada trusted): connected 0, static 1, EIGRP 90, OSPF 110, RIP 120. Pattern: CCNA 200-301 + RPSC ACP/DD.
explanation_hi: AD (कम = अधिक trusted): connected 0, static 1, EIGRP 90, OSPF 110, RIP 120। Pattern: CCNA + RPSC ACP/DD।
nukta_en: AD aur metric alag cheez hain — AD protocols ko compare karti hai.
nukta_hi: AD और metric अलग हैं — AD protocols की तुलना करती है।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: If the Protocol field of an IPv4 header is 17, the transport-layer protocol carried in the datagram is:
stem_hi: यदि IPv4 header का Protocol field 17 हो, तो datagram में लिया गया transport-layer protocol है:
explanation_en: Protocol numbers: 1 = ICMP, 2 = IGMP, 6 = TCP, 17 = UDP, 89 = OSPF. Ye field fragmentation ke saath-saath next-header ki pehchaan deta hai.
explanation_hi: Protocol numbers: 1=ICMP, 2=IGMP, 6=TCP, 17=UDP, 89=OSPF।
nukta_en: 6 TCP, 17 UDP — dono sabse zyada puche jaate hain.
nukta_hi: 6 TCP, 17 UDP — सबसे अधिक पूछे जाते हैं।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: In IPv4 fragmentation, the LAST fragment has the More Fragments (MF) flag set to:
stem_hi: IPv4 fragmentation में, अंतिम fragment का More Fragments (MF) flag होता है:

options.text_en: The same as the first fragment

explanation_en: MF = 1 matlab 'aur fragments aane hain'; aakhri fragment par MF = 0. Har fragment ka offset alag hota hai.
explanation_hi: MF=1 = 'और fragments आने हैं'; अंतिम पर MF=0।
nukta_en: Dono fields (MF flag + offset) milkar reassembly karte hain.
nukta_hi: MF flag + offset मिलकर reassembly करते हैं।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: The Fragment Offset field in the IPv4 header is used to:
stem_hi: IPv4 header का Fragment Offset field प्रयोग होता है:

options.text_en: Place the fragment at its correct position in the original datagram during reassembly
options.text_hi: Reassembly के दौरान fragment को मूल datagram में सही स्थान पर रखने के लिए

options.text_en: Count the total number of fragments

options.text_hi: Fragment payloads encrypt करने के लिए
Fragment का जीवन-काल तय करने के लिए

explanation_en: Offset (8-byte units mein) batata hai fragment original datagram mein kahan baitha hai — destination sirf offset se hi sahi order bana sakta hai.
explanation_hi: Offset (8-byte units में) बताता है fragment का स्थान — इसी से सही क्रम बनता है।
nukta_en: Offset = position; MF = aur aane hain ya nahi.
nukta_hi: Offset = स्थान; MF = और आने हैं या नहीं।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: The data field of an IPv4 datagram can carry:
stem_hi: IPv4 datagram का data field ले जा सकता है:

options.text_en: TCP segment, UDP datagram, or ICMP message — all of these
options.text_hi: TCP segment, UDP datagram, या ICMP message — ये सब

explanation_en: IP ka payload kuch bhi ho sakta hai jo Protocol field bataye — TCP/UDP segments, ICMP/IGMP messages, tunnels mein doosra IP packet bhi.
explanation_hi: IP का payload कुछ भी हो सकता है — TCP/UDP, ICMP/IGMP, या tunnel में दूसरा IP packet।
nukta_en: Protocol field = 6/17/1/2/41... isi se pata chalta hai kya andar hai.
nukta_hi: Protocol field से पता चलता है क्या अंदर है।

subtopic: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
stem_en: RSVP (Resource ReSerVation Protocol) is used by hosts to:
stem_hi: RSVP (Resource ReSerVation Protocol) का उपयोग hosts करते हैं:

options.text_en: Request reservation of network resources (bandwidth) along a path for QoS flows
options.text_hi: QoS flows के लिए रास्ते में network संसाधन (bandwidth) आरक्षित करने के अनुरोध हेतु
स्वतः IP addresses देने के लिए
Domain names हल करने के लिए
Routers के बीच routing tables बाँटने के लिए

explanation_en: RSVP = signalling protocol jo routers se kehta hai ki flow ke liye resources reserve karo (IntServ/QoS). IP assignment = DHCP; routing = OSPF/BGP; names = DNS.
explanation_hi: RSVP = routers से संसाधन आरक्षित करने का संकेत (QoS)। IP=DHCP; routing=OSPF/BGP; names=DNS।
nukta_en: RSVP 'reservation' ka protocol hai — circuit-switching jaisi guarantee nahi, bas soft-state reservations.
nukta_hi: RSVP = soft-state reservations; पूरी guarantee नहीं।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: The size of the TCP header (without options) is:
stem_hi: TCP header का size (options बिना) होता है:
explanation_en: TCP header = 20 bytes; UDP = 8 bytes; IPv4 = 20 bytes.
explanation_hi: TCP = 20 bytes; UDP = 8; IPv4 = 20।
nukta_en: 8 bytes UDP ka.
nukta_hi: 8 bytes UDP का।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: During TCP connection termination, after receiving FIN the receiver sends:
stem_hi: TCP connection समाप्ति में FIN पाने के बाद receiver भेजता है:
explanation_en: FIN ka jawab ACK; phir apna FIN bhejta hai.
explanation_hi: FIN का जवाब ACK।
nukta_en: SYN establishment ke liye.
nukta_hi: SYN establishment के लिए।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: The size of the UDP header is:
stem_hi: UDP header का size होता है:
explanation_en: UDP header = 8 bytes (ports + length + checksum).
explanation_hi: UDP = 8 bytes।
nukta_en: TCP 20 bytes.
nukta_hi: TCP 20 bytes।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: In TCP slow start, the congestion window size:
stem_hi: TCP slow start में congestion window size:

options.text_hi: हर RTT में लगभग दोगुनी होती है

explanation_en: Slow start exponential growth per RTT.
explanation_hi: Slow start per RTT चरम-वृद्धि।
nukta_en: +1 MSS per RTT congestion avoidance hai.
nukta_hi: +1 MSS per RTT = congestion avoidance।

subtopic: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
stem_en: TCP is called a byte-stream protocol because:
stem_hi: TCP को byte-stream protocol कहते हैं क्योंकि:

options.text_en: It does not preserve message boundaries
It works only with bytes files
options.text_hi: यह सिर्फ़ byte files के साथ चलता है

explanation_en: TCP data ko byte stream samajhta hai — message boundaries preserve nahi karta.
explanation_hi: TCP byte stream — सीमाएँ नहीं रखता।

stem_en: TCP provides a byte-stream service. This means that:

explanation_en: TCP sirf reliable ordered BYTE stream deta hai — application ki record boundaries TCP ki zimmedari nahi (isliye application khud length/delimiter bhejti hai). Pattern: RPSC Programmer/ACP/DD + GATE.

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: The term 'CIA triad' in information security refers to:
stem_hi: Information security में 'CIA triad' शब्द किसे कहते हैं?
explanation_en: The CIA triad = Confidentiality (only authorised access), Integrity (no unauthorised change), Availability (accessible when needed) — the three core security goals.
explanation_hi: CIA triad = Confidentiality (केवल authorised access), Integrity (बिना authorisation बदलाव नहीं), Availability (ज़रूरत पर उपलब्ध) — तीन मूल security goals।
nukta_en: CIA = Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability. AAA (authentication, authorisation, accounting) is a separate trio.
nukta_hi: CIA = Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability। AAA (authentication, authorisation, accounting) अलग trio है।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: The goal of 'Integrity' ensures that:
stem_hi: 'Integrity' का लक्ष्य सुनिश्चित करता है कि:

options.text_en: Data can be accessed only by authorised users
options.text_hi: Data can be accessed only by authorised users

options.text_en: Data is accurate and has not been modified
options.text_hi: Data is accurate and has not been modified

options.text_en: Data is always available when needed
options.text_hi: Data is always available when needed

options.text_en: Unauthorised users cannot enter the system
options.text_hi: Unauthorised users cannot enter the system

explanation_en: Integrity means data remains accurate and unaltered except by authorised people — checksums/digital signatures protect it.
explanation_hi: Integrity का अर्थ है data सही और अपरिवर्तित रहे (केवल authorised लोग ही बदलें) — इसे checksums/digital signatures सुरक्षित रखते हैं।
nukta_en: Goal map: Confidentiality = authorised access only. Integrity = no unauthorised change. Availability = always accessible.
nukta_hi: Goal map: Confidentiality = केवल authorised access। Integrity = बिना authorisation बदलाव नहीं। Availability = हमेशा उपलब्ध।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which of the following is NOT a goal of network security?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा network security का लक्ष्य नहीं है?
explanation_en: Redundancy (duplicate links/equipment) improves fault tolerance — it is a reliability technique, not a security goal.
explanation_hi: Redundancy (duplicate links/equipment) fault tolerance बढ़ाती है — यह reliability तकनीक है, security लक्ष्य नहीं।
nukta_en: Security goals = CIA. Reliability goals = redundancy, fault tolerance, recovery.
nukta_hi: Security goals = CIA। Reliability goals = redundancy, fault tolerance, recovery।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: A modification attack violates which security goal?
stem_hi: Modification attack कौन-से security लक्ष्य का उल्लंघन करता है?
explanation_en: A modification attack changes data in transit — that breaks INTEGRITY (data is no longer accurate/unaltered).
explanation_hi: Modification attack रास्ते में data बदल देता है — यह INTEGRITY तोड़ता है (data अब सही/अपरिवर्तित नहीं)।
nukta_en: Attack→goal: Eavesdropping/Interception → Confidentiality. Modification → Integrity. DoS/Interruption → Availability. Spoofing → Authentication.
nukta_hi: Attack→goal: Eavesdropping/Interception → Confidentiality। Modification → Integrity। DoS/Interruption → Availability। Spoofing → Authentication।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which of the following attacks violates confidentiality?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा attack confidentiality का उल्लंघन करता है?
explanation_en: Interception (eavesdropping) lets an unauthorised party READ the data — breaking confidentiality.
explanation_hi: Interception (eavesdropping) से unauthorised पक्ष data पढ़ लेता है — confidentiality टूटती है।
nukta_en: Attack map: Interception→Confidentiality, Modification→Integrity, Fabrication→Authenticity, Interruption→Availability.
nukta_hi: Attack map: Interception→Confidentiality, Modification→Integrity, Fabrication→Authenticity, Interruption→Availability।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: A Denial of Service (DoS) attack violates which goal?
stem_hi: Denial of Service (DoS) attack कौन-से लक्ष्य का उल्लंघन करता है?
explanation_en: A DoS attack floods a server/network so legitimate users cannot access the service — breaking AVAILABILITY.
explanation_hi: DoS attack server/network को flood करके legitimate users को service से रोकता है — Availability टूटती है।
nukta_en: DoS = Availability attack. DDoS = distributed DoS. Smurf/ SYN-flood = DoS variants.
nukta_hi: DoS = Availability attack। DDoS = distributed DoS। Smurf/ SYN-flood = DoS variants।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: A spoofing attack targets which security aspect?
stem_hi: Spoofing attack किस security पहलू को लक्षित करता है?
explanation_en: Spoofing pretends to be someone else (fake IP/MAC/email id) — it attacks AUTHENTICATION (who you claim to be).
explanation_hi: Spoofing किसी और का रूप धारण करता है (fake IP/MAC/email id) — यह AUTHENTICATION पर हमला है (आप कौन हैं)।
nukta_en: Spoofing/impersonation → Authentication. Phishing → steals credentials (auth). Sniffing → Confidentiality.
nukta_hi: Spoofing/impersonation → Authentication। Phishing → credentials चुराता है (auth)। Sniffing → Confidentiality।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which of the following is an ACTIVE attack?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा ACTIVE attack है?
explanation_en: Modification is an active attack — the attacker CHANGES the data stream; interception/traffic analysis/eavesdropping are passive (they only observe).
explanation_hi: Modification एक active attack है — attacker data stream बदलता है; interception/traffic analysis/eavesdropping passive हैं (केवल देखते हैं)।
nukta_en: Passive = observe only (eavesdropping, traffic analysis). Active = change/disrupt (modification, fabrication, interruption/DoS).
nukta_hi: Passive = केवल देखना (eavesdropping, traffic analysis)। Active = बदलना/बाधा (modification, fabrication, interruption/DoS)।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: The primary difference between active and passive attacks is:
stem_hi: Active और passive attacks के बीच मुख्य अंतर क्या है?

options.text_en: Active attacks change data; passive attacks do not
options.text_hi: Active attacks change data; passive attacks do not

explanation_en: Active attacks intercept AND modify/disrupt the communication; passive attacks only eavesdrop without changing anything.
explanation_hi: Active attacks संचार को intercept करके बदलते/बाधित करते हैं; passive attacks केवल सुनते हैं, कुछ नहीं बदलते।
nukta_en: Active: modification, fabrication, interruption. Passive: eavesdropping, traffic analysis. Exam one-liner: 'change vs observe'.
nukta_hi: Active: modification, fabrication, interruption। Passive: eavesdropping, traffic analysis। Exam one-liner: 'change बनाम observe'।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: In the virus life cycle, which phase actually performs the malicious activity?
stem_hi: Virus life cycle में कौन-सा phase वास्तव में malicious activity करता है?
explanation_en: The execution phase runs the payload — the actual damage (deleting files, corrupting data).
explanation_hi: Execution phase payload चलाता है — वास्तविक नुकसान (files delete करना, data खराब करना)।
nukta_en: Virus phases: Dormant (idle) → Propagation (copy) → Triggering (condition met) → Execution (payload runs).
nukta_hi: Virus phases: Dormant (idle) → Propagation (copy) → Triggering (condition met) → Execution (payload runs)।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which backup medium provides Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) functionality?
stem_hi: कौन-सा backup medium Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) functionality देता है?
explanation_en: CD-R/DVD-R optical disks are WORM — data is written once and cannot be altered, making them tamper-proof archives.
explanation_hi: CD-R/DVD-R optical disks WORM हैं — data एक बार लिखा जाता है और बदला नहीं जा सकता, इसलिए ये tamper-proof archives हैं।
nukta_en: WORM = optical write-once media (CD-R/DVD-R/BD-R). Rewritable: HDD, tape (LTO), flash, CD-RW.
nukta_hi: WORM = optical write-once media (CD-R/DVD-R/BD-R)। Rewritable: HDD, tape (LTO), flash, CD-RW।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which attack becomes possible if the SAME key is reused many times in symmetric encryption?
stem_hi: यदि symmetric encryption में एक ही key कई बार उपयोग हो, तो कौन-सा attack संभव हो जाता है?
explanation_en: With many ciphertexts under one key, an attacker can compare them with known plaintexts and deduce the key — a known-plaintext (or frequency-analysis) attack.
explanation_hi: एक key के अंतर्गत अनेक ciphertexts होने पर attacker उन्हें known plaintexts से मिलाकर key निकाल सकता है — known-plaintext (या frequency-analysis) attack।
nukta_en: One-time pads are safe ONLY with a fresh key per message. Reuse → pattern analysis. Exam favourite link: key reuse → known-plaintext.
nukta_hi: One-time pads केवल हर message पर नई key से सुरक्षित हैं। Reuse → pattern analysis। Exam favourite link: key reuse → known-plaintext।

nukta_hi: Security tools: Wireshark = packet analyser, Nmap = port scanner, Cain&Abel = password cracker, Angry IP Scanner = IP scanner, Snort = IDS।

explanation_hi: Angry IP Scanner IP ranges और open ports scan करने वाला लोकप्रिय free tool है।

nukta_hi: Cain&Abel = password cracking; Angry IP = IP/port scan; Snort = IDS; Ettercap = sniffing/ARP spoofing।

stem_hi: हमलों को उनके विवरण से मिलाइए: (a) Phishing  (b) DoS Attack  (c) Man-in-the-Middle  (d) Spoofing — (i) नेटवर्क ट्रैफ़िक भरना  (ii) यूज़र जानकारी चुराना  (iii) संचार में हस्तक्षेप  (iv) पहचान की नकल

nukta_hi: Attack one-liners: Phishing=fake emails/sites, DoS=flood, MitM=middle interception, Spoofing=fake identity।
