stem_en: The text that gets transformed using a cipher algorithm is called:
stem_hi: Cipher algorithm से जिस text को बदला जाता है उसे क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: The INPUT to the cipher is the plaintext; after transformation it becomes ciphertext.
explanation_hi: Cipher का INPUT plaintext है; बदलने के बाद वह ciphertext बनता है।
nukta_en: Cryptography flow: Plain text --(cipher + key)--> Ciphertext --(decipher + key)--> Plain text.
nukta_hi: Cryptography flow: Plain text --(cipher + key)--> Ciphertext --(decipher + key)--> Plain text।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which statement about plaintext, ciphertext and key is MOST accurate?
stem_hi: Plaintext, ciphertext और key के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सबसे सही है?

options.text_en: Plaintext is generated after decryption using a public key
options.text_hi: Plaintext is generated after decryption using a public key

options.text_en: Ciphertext is the original readable message
options.text_hi: Ciphertext is the original readable message

options.text_en: Plaintext is transformed into ciphertext using an algorithm and a key
options.text_hi: Plaintext is transformed into ciphertext using an algorithm and a key

options.text_en: Ciphertext and plaintext are always of the same length
options.text_hi: Ciphertext and plaintext are always of the same length

explanation_en: Encryption transforms plaintext into ciphertext using a cipher algorithm together with a key — this is the precise description.
explanation_hi: Encryption एक cipher algorithm और key के साथ plaintext को ciphertext में बदलता है — यही सटीक विवरण है।
nukta_en: Remember the 3 objects: plaintext (readable), ciphertext (scrambled), key (secret parameter). Encryption = f(plaintext, key).
nukta_hi: 3 objects याद रखें: plaintext (पढ़ने योग्य), ciphertext (scrambled), key (गुप्त parameter)। Encryption = f(plaintext, key)।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which of the following uses the SAME key for encryption and decryption?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा encryption और decryption के लिए एक ही key उपयोग करता है?
explanation_en: Symmetric cryptography uses one shared secret key for both encryption and decryption (AES, DES, Blowfish).
explanation_hi: Symmetric cryptography encryption और decryption दोनों के लिए एक ही shared secret key उपयोग करता है (AES, DES, Blowfish)।
nukta_en: Symmetric = 1 key (fast). Asymmetric = key pair (public+private, slow). Hash = one-way digest. Signature = private-sign/public-verify.
nukta_hi: Symmetric = 1 key (तेज़)। Asymmetric = key pair (public+private, धीमा)। Hash = one-way digest। Signature = private-sign/public-verify।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which of the following uses a PAIR of keys (public and private)?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा keys की एक जोड़ी (public और private) उपयोग करता है?
explanation_en: Asymmetric (public-key) cryptography uses a mathematically linked key pair — public key to encrypt, private key to decrypt (RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman).
explanation_hi: Asymmetric (public-key) cryptography गणितीय रूप से जुड़ी key pair उपयोग करता है — encrypt के लिए public key, decrypt के लिए private key (RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman)।
nukta_en: Public-key examples: RSA, Diffie-Hellman, ECC, DSA. Symmetric: DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, RC4.
nukta_hi: Public-key examples: RSA, Diffie-Hellman, ECC, DSA। Symmetric: DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, RC4।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which is FASTER in encryption and decryption?
stem_hi: Encryption और decryption में कौन-सा तेज़ है?
explanation_en: Symmetric ciphers (AES/DES) are orders of magnitude faster than asymmetric ones (RSA) — that's why bulk data uses symmetric encryption.
explanation_hi: Symmetric ciphers (AES/DES), asymmetric (RSA) से कई गुना तेज़ होते हैं — इसीलिए bulk data में symmetric encryption होती है।
nukta_en: Speed: Symmetric >> Asymmetric. Hybrid systems (TLS/PGP) use asymmetric KEYS to exchange a symmetric SESSION key.
nukta_hi: Speed: Symmetric >> Asymmetric। Hybrid systems (TLS/PGP) asymmetric KEYS से symmetric SESSION key का आदान-प्रदान करती हैं।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: What is the main disadvantage of symmetric key encryption?
stem_hi: Symmetric key encryption की मुख्य कमी क्या है?
explanation_en: Both sides must share the SAME secret key securely — key distribution over an insecure channel is the classic problem.
explanation_hi: दोनों पक्षों को एक ही secret key सुरक्षित रूप से साझा करनी होती है — insecure channel पर key distribution ही classic समस्या है।
nukta_en: Symmetric weakness = key distribution (n users → n(n-1)/2 keys). Asymmetric weakness = slow + key authenticity (certificates).
nukta_hi: Symmetric कमज़ोरी = key distribution (n users → n(n-1)/2 keys)। Asymmetric कमज़ोरी = धीमा + key authenticity (certificates)।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Public key is used to:
stem_hi: Public key का उपयोग किसके लिए होता है?
explanation_en: In public-key cryptography anyone can use the recipient's PUBLIC key to encrypt; only the recipient's PRIVATE key can decrypt.
explanation_hi: Public-key cryptography में कोई भी प्राप्तकर्ता की PUBLIC key से encrypt कर सकता है; केवल प्राप्तकर्ता की PRIVATE key से decrypt होता है।
nukta_en: Encrypt with public → decrypt with private. SIGN with private → verify with public. Exam asks both directions!
nukta_hi: Encrypt public से → decrypt private से। SIGN private से → verify public से। Exam दोनों दिशाएँ पूछता है!

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: In public-key cryptography, a message encrypted with the public key can only be decrypted by:
stem_hi: Public-key cryptography में public key से encrypt किया संदेश केवल किसके द्वारा decrypt हो सकता है?

options.text_en: The private key corresponding to that public key
options.text_hi: The private key corresponding to that public key

explanation_en: Only the matching private key of the key pair can decrypt what the public key encrypted.
explanation_hi: केवल उस key pair की मेल खाती private key ही public key से encrypt किए गए संदेश को decrypt कर सकती है।
nukta_en: Public/private are mathematically paired — like a lock (public) and its only key (private).
nukta_hi: Public/private गणितीय रूप से जुड़े हैं — एक ताला (public) और उसकी एकमात्र चाबी (private) की तरह।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which statement about symmetric and asymmetric cryptography is TRUE?
stem_hi: Symmetric और asymmetric cryptography के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?

options.text_en: Asymmetric cryptography is faster than symmetric
options.text_hi: Asymmetric cryptography is faster than symmetric

options.text_en: Symmetric cryptography requires secure key exchange
options.text_hi: Symmetric cryptography requires secure key exchange

explanation_en: Symmetric cryptography requires a SECURE key exchange between the parties — that is its defining practical challenge.
explanation_hi: Symmetric cryptography के लिए पक्षों के बीच सुरक्षित key exchange आवश्यक है — यही इसकी मुख्य व्यावहारिक चुनौती है।
nukta_en: True: symmetric needs secure key exchange. False: symmetric does not inherently authenticate; asymmetric is slower; symmetric uses ONE key.
nukta_hi: सही: symmetric को secure key exchange चाहिए। गलत: symmetric स्वयं authentication नहीं देता; asymmetric धीमा; symmetric एक key उपयोग करता है।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Data Encryption Standard (DES) is a:
stem_hi: Data Encryption Standard (DES) क्या है?
explanation_en: DES encrypts data in 64-bit blocks using a 56-bit key — a classic symmetric BLOCK cipher.
explanation_hi: DES data को 64-bit blocks में 56-bit key से encrypt करता है — एक classic symmetric BLOCK cipher।
nukta_en: DES = 64-bit block, 56-bit key (symmetric). AES = 128-bit block. RC4 = stream cipher.
nukta_hi: DES = 64-bit block, 56-bit key (symmetric)। AES = 128-bit block। RC4 = stream cipher।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: What is the key length of AES-256 encryption?
stem_hi: AES-256 encryption की key length कितनी है?
explanation_en: AES-256 uses a 256-bit key (the number in the name is the key length).
explanation_hi: AES-256 में 256-bit key उपयोग होती है (नाम में संख्या key length है)।
nukta_en: AES variants: AES-128, AES-192, AES-256 (key sizes). Block size is always 128 bits.
nukta_hi: AES variants: AES-128, AES-192, AES-256 (key sizes)। Block size हमेशा 128 bits।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which cipher method encrypts one bit or byte at a time?
stem_hi: कौन-सी cipher method एक बार में एक bit या byte encrypt करती है?
explanation_en: A stream cipher encrypts the data one bit (or byte) at a time as a continuous stream (e.g., RC4).
explanation_hi: Stream cipher data को एक समय में एक bit (या byte) encrypt करती है, एक निरंतर धारा के रूप में (जैसे RC4)।
nukta_en: Stream = 1 bit/byte at a time (RC4, A5/1). Block = fixed-size blocks (DES/AES). Substitution/Transposition = classical techniques.
nukta_hi: Stream = 1 bit/byte at a time (RC4, A5/1)। Block = fixed-size blocks (DES/AES)। Substitution/Transposition = classical techniques।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which of the following statements is FALSE?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा कथन गलत है?

options.text_en: Diffie-Hellman is used for key exchange
options.text_hi: Diffie-Hellman is used for key exchange

explanation_en: RSA is an ASYMMETRIC (public-key) cipher — the statement 'RSA is symmetric' is false.
explanation_hi: RSA एक ASYMMETRIC (public-key) cipher है — 'RSA symmetric है' कथन गलत है।
nukta_en: False-statement MCQs: check each. AES=block ✓, RSA=asymmetric ✗, DH=key exchange ✓, DES=symmetric ✓.
nukta_hi: False-statement MCQs: हर एक जाँचें। AES=block ✓, RSA=asymmetric ✗, DH=key exchange ✓, DES=symmetric ✓।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: In the digital signature technique, when the whole message is signed using an asymmetric key, the receiver uses:
stem_hi: Digital signature technique में, जब पूरा संदेश asymmetric key से sign होता है, तो प्राप्तकर्ता उपयोग करता है:

options.text_en: Her or his own public key
options.text_hi: Her or his own public key

options.text_en: Her or his own private key
options.text_hi: Her or his own private key

explanation_en: The sender signs with their PRIVATE key; the receiver verifies the signature using the SENDER'S PUBLIC key.
explanation_hi: भेजने वाला अपनी PRIVATE key से sign करता है; प्राप्तकर्ता भेजने वाले की PUBLIC key से signature सत्यापित करता है।
nukta_en: Signature direction: SIGN with private → VERIFY with public. Encryption direction: ENCRYPT with public → DECRYPT with private.
nukta_hi: Signature दिशा: private से SIGN → public से VERIFY। Encryption दिशा: public से ENCRYPT → private से DECRYPT।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: The Caesar Cipher is an example of which cryptographic technique?
stem_hi: Caesar Cipher किस cryptographic technique का उदाहरण है?
explanation_en: The Caesar cipher replaces each letter by another a fixed number of places down the alphabet — a classical SUBSTITUTION cipher.
explanation_hi: Caesar cipher में हर अक्षर को वर्णमाला में कुछ स्थान आगे वाले अक्षर से बदला जाता है — एक classical SUBSTITUTION cipher।
nukta_en: Classical types: Substitution (Caesar, Playfair) = replace; Transposition (Rail fence) = rearrange.
nukta_hi: Classical types: Substitution (Caesar, Playfair) = replace; Transposition (Rail fence) = rearrange।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: The process of detecting hidden data inside a file is known as:
stem_hi: किसी file के भीतर छिपे data का पता लगाने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: Steganalysis is the art of detecting/extracting data hidden by steganography.
explanation_hi: Steganalysis, steganography से छिपाए गए data का पता लगाने/निकालने की कला है।
nukta_en: Steganography = HIDING data (cover file). Steganalysis = DETECTING it. Cryptography = scrambling it.
nukta_hi: Steganography = data छिपाना (cover file)। Steganalysis = पता लगाना। Cryptography = scramblइंग।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: What is the output of a steganography process called?
stem_hi: Steganography प्रक्रिया के output को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: The carrier file that now contains the hidden message is called the stego-object.
explanation_hi: वह carrier file जिसमें अब छिपा संदेश है, stego-object कहलाती है।
nukta_en: Stego terms: cover file (original carrier), secret message (hidden data), stego-object (result).
nukta_hi: Stego terms: cover file (original carrier), secret message (hidden data), stego-object (result)।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: In steganography, the file used to hide the secret data is called:
stem_hi: Steganography में secret data छिपाने के लिए जिस file का उपयोग होता है उसे क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: The innocent-looking carrier (image/audio/document) that hides the secret data is called the cover file.
explanation_hi: वह मासूम दिखने वाली carrier (image/audio/document) जो secret data छिपाती है, cover file कहलाती है।
nukta_en: Cover file = the disguise. Secret message = hidden data. Stego-object = cover + secret after embedding.
nukta_hi: Cover file = छद्म वेश। Secret message = छिपा data। Stego-object = embedding के बाद cover + secret।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which of the following is an example of asymmetric encryption?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा asymmetric encryption का उदाहरण है?
explanation_en: RSA is the classic public-key (asymmetric) algorithm; AES, DES and Blowfish are all symmetric.
explanation_hi: RSA classic public-key (asymmetric) algorithm है; AES, DES और Blowfish सब symmetric हैं।
nukta_en: Asymmetric = RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman, DSA. Symmetric = DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, RC4, IDEA.
nukta_hi: Asymmetric = RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman, DSA। Symmetric = DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, RC4, IDEA।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: The data to be encrypted at the sender's site is called ______ and the data to be decrypted at the receiver's end is called ______.
stem_hi: Sender की ओर encrypt किए जाने वाले data को ______ और receiver की ओर decrypt किए जाने वाले data को ______ कहते हैं.
explanation_en: मूल data = Plain text; encrypt होने के बाद = Cipher text. Receiver पर cipher text decrypt होकर फिर plain text बनता है.
explanation_hi: मूल data = Plain text; encrypt होने के बाद = Cipher text. Receiver पर cipher text decrypt होकर फिर plain text बनता है.
nukta_en: याद रखो: Plain (सादा) → encrypt → Cipher (गूँथा) → decrypt → Plain.
nukta_hi: याद रखो: Plain (सादा) → encrypt → Cipher (गूँथा) → decrypt → Plain.

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Suppose everyone in a group of N people wants to communicate secretly with the N−1 others using a symmetric-key cryptographic system. The number of keys required in the system as a whole is:
stem_hi: मान लीजिए N लोगों के समूह में हर व्यक्ति बाकी N−1 लोगों से symmetric-key cryptographic system से गुप्त बातचीत करना चाहता है. कुल कितने keys चाहिए होंगी?
explanation_en: Symmetric keys are shared in pairs — one key per pair. N people need N(N−1)/2 pairs.
explanation_hi: Symmetric keys जोड़ों में बँटती हैं — हर जोड़े की एक key. N लोगों के जोड़े = N(N−1)/2.
nukta_en: GATE key (c). Public-key में यह समस्या नहीं — इसीलिए hybrid systems आए.
nukta_hi: GATE key (c). Public-key में यह समस्या नहीं — इसीलिए hybrid systems आए.

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: What is the advantage of setting up a DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) using a firewall?
stem_hi: Firewall का उपयोग करके DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) बनाने का क्या लाभ है?

options.text_en: To create multiple zones of trust
options.text_hi: To create multiple zones of trust

options.text_en: Bringing internet service into a home
options.text_hi: Bringing internet service into a home

explanation_en: A DMZ creates separate trust zones — public servers (web/mail) sit in the DMZ so attackers don't directly reach the internal trusted network.
explanation_hi: DMZ अलग trust zones बनाता है — public servers (web/mail) DMZ में रहते हैं ताकि attackers सीधे internal trusted network तक न पहुँचें।
nukta_en: unverified supplied answer-table claim. DMZ = buffer zone between untrusted Internet and trusted LAN (3 zones: external / DMZ / internal).
nukta_hi: unverified supplied answer-table claim। DMZ = untrusted Internet और trusted LAN के बीच buffer zone (3 zones: external / DMZ / internal)।

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: Match the security mechanisms with their OSI layers: (a) Firewall  (b) Digital Signature  (c) MAC Filtering  (d) Port-based Filtering — (i) Network Layer  (ii) Application Layer  (iii) Data Link Layer  (iv) Transport Layer
stem_hi: Security mechanisms को OSI layers से मिलाइए: (a) Firewall  (b) Digital Signature  (c) MAC Filtering  (d) Port-based Filtering — (i) Network Layer  (ii) Application Layer  (iii) Data Link Layer  (iv) Transport Layer
explanation_en: Firewall rules work at the network layer (IP), digital signatures are application-level, MAC filtering is data-link, and port filtering is transport-level (TCP/UDP ports).
explanation_hi: Firewall rules network layer (IP) पर, digital signatures application level पर, MAC filtering data-link पर, और port filtering transport level (TCP/UDP ports) पर काम करते हैं।
nukta_en: Mechanism-layers: Firewall L3/L4 (IP), Port filter L4, MAC filter L2, Digital signature L7. Packet-filtering firewall = L3/L4.
nukta_hi: Mechanism-layers: Firewall L3/L4 (IP), Port filter L4, MAC filter L2, Digital signature L7। Packet-filtering firewall = L3/L4।

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: Match the security protocols with their OSI layers: (a) IPSec  (b) SSL/TLS  (c) PGP  (d) WPA2 — (i) Application Layer  (ii) Network Layer  (iii) Transport/Presentation Layer  (iv) Data Link Layer (Wi-Fi)
stem_hi: Security protocols को OSI layers से मिलाइए: (a) IPSec  (b) SSL/TLS  (c) PGP  (d) WPA2 — (i) Application Layer  (ii) Network Layer  (iii) Transport/Presentation Layer  (iv) Data Link Layer (Wi-Fi)
explanation_en: IPSec secures at the network layer (L3), SSL/TLS at transport/presentation, PGP is an application-layer mail security tool, and WPA2 protects Wi-Fi at the data-link layer.
explanation_hi: IPSec network layer (L3) पर, SSL/TLS transport/presentation पर, PGP application-layer mail security tool है, और WPA2 Wi-Fi को data-link layer पर सुरक्षित करता है।
nukta_en: Protocol layers: IPSec L3, SSL/TLS L4-7 (exam: transport/presentation), PGP L7, WPA2 L2, Kerberos L7.
nukta_hi: Protocol layers: IPSec L3, SSL/TLS L4-7 (exam: transport/presentation), PGP L7, WPA2 L2, Kerberos L7।

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: IPSec is MOST commonly used to implement:
stem_hi: IPSec मुख्यतः किसके लिए उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: IPSec provides encrypted tunnels over the internet — the foundation of most site-to-site and remote-access VPNs.
explanation_hi: IPSec internet पर encrypted tunnels देता है — अधिकांश site-to-site और remote-access VPNs की नींव।
nukta_en: IPSec = VPN tunneling (ESP/AH). Secure email = PGP/SMIME. Secure web = SSL/TLS. Wireless = WPA2.
nukta_hi: IPSec = VPN tunneling (ESP/AH)। Secure email = PGP/SMIME। Secure web = SSL/TLS। Wireless = WPA2।

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: IPSec operates in which mode(s)?
stem_hi: IPSec किस/किन mode(s) में काम करता है?

options.text_en: Both transport mode and tunnel mode
options.text_hi: Both transport mode and tunnel mode

explanation_en: IPSec has two modes — transport mode (protects the payload, end-to-end) and tunnel mode (protects the whole IP packet, gateway-to-gateway).
explanation_hi: IPSec के दो modes हैं — transport mode (payload सुरक्षित, end-to-end) और tunnel mode (पूरा IP packet सुरक्षित, gateway-to-gateway)।
nukta_en: IPSec modes: Transport (payload only, host-to-host) & Tunnel (full packet, gateway-to-gateway/VPN).
nukta_hi: IPSec modes: Transport (केवल payload, host-to-host) और Tunnel (पूरा packet, gateway-to-gateway/VPN)।

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: In IPSec Tunnel mode:
stem_hi: IPSec Tunnel mode में:

options.text_en: The entire IP packet is encrypted
options.text_hi: The entire IP packet is encrypted

explanation_en: Tunnel mode encrypts the ENTIRE original IP packet (header + payload) and adds a new header — used for VPN gateways.
explanation_hi: Tunnel mode पूरे original IP packet (header + payload) को encrypt करके नया header जोड़ता है — VPN gateways के लिए उपयोग।
nukta_en: Tunnel = whole packet + new header (gateway VPN). Transport = payload only (host-to-host).
nukta_hi: Tunnel = पूरा packet + नया header (gateway VPN)। Transport = केवल payload (host-to-host)।

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: Which mode of IPSec provides end-to-end security between two hosts?
stem_hi: IPSec का कौन-सा mode दो hosts के बीच end-to-end security देता है?
explanation_en: Transport mode secures communication directly between two hosts (end-to-end) — only the payload is protected.
explanation_hi: Transport mode दो hosts के बीच सीधे संचार सुरक्षित करता है (end-to-end) — केवल payload सुरक्षित होता है।
nukta_en: End-to-end (host↔host) = Transport mode. Gateway↔gateway (VPN) = Tunnel mode.
nukta_hi: End-to-end (host↔host) = Transport mode। Gateway↔gateway (VPN) = Tunnel mode।

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: The SSL/TLS handshake protocol is mainly used for:
stem_hi: SSL/TLS handshake protocol मुख्यतः किसके लिए उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: The handshake negotiates cipher suites, authenticates the server (certificates) and exchanges keys for the session.
explanation_hi: Handshake cipher suites का निर्णय करता है, server को authenticate करता है (certificates) और session के लिए keys का आदान-प्रदान करता है।
nukta_en: TLS parts: Handshake = keys+authentication; Record = encryption+integrity. HTTPS = HTTP over TLS (port 443).
nukta_hi: TLS parts: Handshake = keys+authentication; Record = encryption+integrity। HTTPS = HTTP over TLS (port 443)।

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: Which of the following is used in HTTPS for encryption?
stem_hi: HTTPS में encryption के लिए निम्न में से क्या उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: HTTPS = HTTP over SSL/TLS — the TLS layer encrypts the HTTP traffic (port 443).
explanation_hi: HTTPS = HTTP over SSL/TLS — TLS layer HTTP traffic को encrypt करता है (port 443)।
nukta_en: HTTPS = HTTP + SSL/TLS (443). HTTP = 80 (no encryption). FTP = 21. ARP = IP→MAC. NAT = address translation.
nukta_hi: HTTPS = HTTP + SSL/TLS (443)। HTTP = 80 (encryption नहीं)। FTP = 21। ARP = IP→MAC। NAT = address translation।

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: In which layer of the network architecture is the Secure Socket Layer (SSL) used?
stem_hi: Secure Socket Layer (SSL) network architecture की किस layer में उपयोग होती है?
explanation_en: Exam banks place SSL at the Session layer — it establishes a secure session between application and transport (technically it sits between L4 and L7).
explanation_hi: Exam banks SSL को Session layer पर रखते हैं — यह application और transport के बीच secure session बनाती है (तकनीकी रूप से यह L4 और L7 के बीच है)।
nukta_en: Exam convention: SSL = Session layer (secure session setup + negotiation). Note: TLS = successor of SSL.
nukta_hi: Exam convention: SSL = Session layer (secure session setup + negotiation)। नोट: TLS, SSL का उत्तराधिकारी है।

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: When a logic bomb is activated by a time-related event, it is known as a:
stem_hi: जब कोई logic bomb किसी समय-संबंधी घटना से सक्रिय होता है, तो उसे कहते हैं:
explanation_en: A logic bomb driven by date/time is a Time bomb (like the Friday-13 virus).
explanation_hi: समय/तारीख़ से चलने वाला logic bomb = Time bomb (जैसे शुक्रवार-13 वायरस).
nukta_en: Logic bomb = code that explodes on a condition; if the condition is time, it is a Time bomb.
nukta_hi: Logic bomb = शर्त से फटने वाला कोड; शर्त समय हो तो Time bomb.

subtopic: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
stem_en: Verification based on a login ID and password is called:
stem_hi: Login ID और password के आधार पर जाँच कहलाती है:
explanation_en: Checking identity (ID + password) = Authentication. This is the first door of security.
